Looking ahead, I'll start to focus on where Democrats have opportunities in '26. | | | Sep 24 | | | | | | | | | | | | As someone who pays close attention to the news, I thought this past week was exhausting. I'm not going to relitigate all of it,1 because it's too easy to become a fatalist or a nihilist if you're only paying attention to the bad news. So, for the next couple of posts, I'm going to focus instead on the positive, namely where I think Democrats have opportunities to change the narrative and win (or win back) voters.2 What I'll talk through in this post: the Trump administration is using the might of the federal government to come down hard on free speech. This is dangerous for America--and an opportunity for Democrats, if they choose to take it. ? Article summary: Americans across the board feel less comfortable sharing their opinions and worry that the government is threatening their rights to free speech. That fear is especially present for Republicans and young men --creating an opportunity for Democrats to win back a demographic that's moving away from them. Democrats can own the issue of free speech, but it 'll require them to have difficult conversations in uncomfortable spaces. They haven't always done that well. Free speech had a rough week In case you need a reminder, here's why this is salient: Trump threatened to that are "against" him. Jimmy Kimmel, after making a joke related to Trump's reaction to Charlie Kirk's assassination, . (.) , the chairman of the Federal Communications Commission, (which owns ABC) to pull the show: "Frankly, when you see stuff like this--I mean, we can do this the easy way or the hard way."3 Americans worry about losing their free speech All of this is notable because Americans, for a while now, have become increasingly worried about their freedom of speech.4 In 2020, felt that they were less free to speak their mind than they once were. For context, only 13% of Americans felt that way during the height of McCarthyism , a period famous for its suppression of free speech. Five years on, people--especially men and Republicans--worry that they can't freely express their opinions.5 say that "the biggest threat to free speech is the government" vs. 25% who say that's not the case--and this poll was done back in February. A more recent survey (from Sept. 19) finds that Americans believe the to free speech. say that "freedom of speech has become more limited during my lifetime," vs. 24% who say that's not the case. agree that free speech has become more limited, and say that they're not comfortable sharing their political opinions (vs. 22% of women).6 Let's look more at , specifically focusing on partisan and gender divides. , vs. 48% of Democrats, say that the government is the biggest threat to free speech.7 69% of Republicans, vs. 48% of Democrats, say that free speech has become more limited in their lifetime. All of this is an opportunity for Democrats to create a wedge issue--especially for young men, in the last election.8 | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | July 1, 2024 | Ted Cruz is right (?!) I'd seen the reporting that FCC Chairman Carr's "the easy way or the hard way" comment, but I wanted to listen for myself. Here's , from the 21:11 mark.9 Cruz's logic for being against Carr's comment isn't necessarily mine. His take, basically, is that if Republicans weaponize the FCC now, just imagine what the Democrats will do when they're in power! But the broader point--that it's a very dangerous precedent for the government to threaten the revocation of broadcast licenses for stations whose programming they don't like--is a good one, and one where I agree with what Cruz is saying. Ted Cruz here , by the way, and there are and right-leaning media personalities who are coming out and saying the same. Some of this, I'm sure, is driven by the genuine philosophical belief that this is wrong. But these people (usually) aren't fools, and I think they see that the Trump administration is creating an opening for Democrats that wasn't there before. The left needs to own up to its mistakes on this issue During the Biden years, a well-worn Republican talking point-- that the Democrats, in cahoots with the largest tech companies, were censoring free speech. That's a bit of a different conversation, because tech companies aren't part of the government,10 but the point was clearly resonant. Either way, in this context, Democrats need to reckon with the fact that things were taken too far in the wake of the George Floyd protests in 2020 and into the early years of the Biden presidency. , it was a heated moment, and in 2020 felt less free to speak their minds than they'd felt before. The New York Times from a sitting United States Senator, which was crazy then and seems crazier in hindsight. It ultimately led to and the persistent accusation-- the NYT had become too activist. Fair or not, the party of the "woke" and all that entails, something . Universities, which should be the home of open debate and discourse, . For a while, there was a real sense that saying the wrong thing (at work, on social media, etc.) . Does that last point sound familiar? We're seeing something very similar happen , I'll note.11 There was also a sense, a few years ago, that Big Tech was in the pocket of the left. , and , it's impossible to make that argument anymore. Here's the opportunity for Democrats This is where I see an opening: The perceived crackdown on language and open discourse, especially once it accelerated in 2020, was unpopular and led to pushback from voters. Here's a chance to reshape the narrative. Tech companies, which are squarely in the pocket of the President now. and ; Democrats can and should flip that narrative too. People worry their free speech is under attack--with good reason. The President and his administration are very explicitly using government power to attack our right to free speech. Democrats should lean in hard on this issue. Go after Republicans who have rolled over (and call out their hypocrisy). Go on Republican talk shows and podcasts.13 Don't worry about placating the annoying Democrats of Twitter, , much less the average voter. There's a chance to make inroads here with voters of all stripes, especially Republicans and young men. But that requires showing that Democrats can put their money where their mouth is, and have uncomfortable conversations in unfamiliar spaces. Standing up for free speech is only hard when you're talking to people whose views you find objectionable. Address the dangers of Big Tech and the perils of FCC overreach on Fox News and conservative talk radio; talk to Ben Shapiro and Megyn Kelly about policy proposals to depoliticize the FCC (to protect against the excesses of either party).14 This is an issue where calling out Republican hypocrisy would bolster the argument that Democrats are making--especially if Democrats can honestly acknowledge their own issues in the past. I hope our elected officials and candidates are up to that challenge. ? Feel free to share this post with someone who will find this interesting. We ended up talking about politics, and not knowing anything about how Grant votes, I asked him a more general question: what's the political issue that you care most about? Grant's answer: he felt like people weren't able to have a civil conversation anymore. He and his friends were worried that anything they said would ostracize friends, or get them cancelled. (Even if he recognized that "cancellation" is a pretty amorphous concept.) He's never lived in a pre-social media world and has the sense, right or wrong, that people used to more freely debate and more civilly disagree in the past. Data is not the plural of anecdote, but Grant clearly isn't alone here. 5 The two things are correlated these days--i.e., men are more likely to be Republicans--so it's a little hard to disentangle that in the polling. I'm coming alongside this school board race because I know enough to know this: **who sits on your school board matters.**
Did you know that in Pennsylvania, your local school board has the power to raise your taxes? They do. And haven't we already been squeezed enough? Families are paying more at the pump, at the grocery store, and on their mortgages. The last thing we need is another tax hike rubber-stamped by a school board.
This Substack is reader-supported. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9rYXRoeWJhcm5ldHRlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Q361Nbsem1tRd4koMgDRx17bDCwFsxcO04Sy9T9D-aI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=174436582)
But it's not just about taxes. Did you know that one of the Democrat parents running for school board began transitioning his _first-grader_? That's right. First grade. If you've been paying attention over the past eight years, you know how deeply these decisions ripple into the lives of our children and our communities. It matters.
That's why I'm co-hosting a fundraiser to help these brave candidates--candidates who are standing up for sanity and responsibility--get the tools they need to win. Yard signs. Mailers. Every single thing that helps their message reach voters.
**And here 's my promise to you:**
Every dollar you donate will go directly to these candidates. No fluff. No middlemen. Just boots-on-the-ground support for people willing to fight for your children and your wallet.
This is where the battle begins--at the local level. If we lose the ground under our feet, what chance do we have at the national level?
Join me. Let's make sure our schools and our taxes are protected by leaders who actually reflect our values. Also, if you're able to stop by next week I would love to see you. Blessings...

* $4,000+ on catering from fancy restaurants
* $50,000+ on bottled water
* $300,000 on out-of-state travel
* There's even a stipend for clothing at the Lottery!

The Massachusetts Republican Party is determined to launch a top-tier candidate for Treasurer, but we need the funds to help defeat Goldberg in 2026.

| Momentum is building. Every single week, more Republicans step forward ready to run in 2026 because they see what we see: the tide is turning in Massachusetts.
That's something we've seen especially in recent days, as thousands of conservatives from every corner of the state came together for vigils remembering Charlie Kirk.
Our leaders are being shot at for telling the truth, but they aren't quitting. Neither are we.
The mission for the MassGOP is clear: recruit strong Conservative candidates and equip them with the resources to take on the deep pockets of unions and far-left Democrat groups.

It's been two weeks since the murder of Charlie Kirk, and I've been thinking about our search for unity after tragedy, especially in a country as divided as ours. I keep coming back to the contrast. Erika Kirk showed extraordinary grace at the memorial service, [forgiving the man who killed her husband](https://substack.com/redirect/b5f1f5d1-1940-46d1-b43a-d5b28aa408d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), saying, "The answer to hate is not hate. The answer we know from the gospel is love and always love. Love for our enemies and love for those who persecute us."
It's a message that we could all take to heart.
Meanwhile, at the same memorial, President Trump, ever a class act, said, "I hate my opponents and I don't want the best for them." He's talking about his fellow Americans he's supposed to lead.
That's the divide we live in--somewhere between forgiveness and fury. It's a divide so deep that Jimmy Kimmel's show was canceled and then uncanceled in the span of a news cycle over comments he made about Kirk's alleged shooter (not even about Kirk himself).
It would be nice to pivot toward hope.
It's Rosh Hashanah-- the Jewish New Year. _Shana tova_ to all my Jewish readers. How fitting that a holiday devoted to renewal and reflection coincides with the start of fall. It's a reminder that we each can turn a new leaf.
But Washington hasn't gotten the memo.
If my work resonates with you, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..skcoVyAUObxDt1Dba0oeEmKF0RT7H_QOzvqLAig7Nqc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=174440829)
# Another Trump Shutdown Looms
If Congress doesn't pass a funding bill by September 30--the end of the fiscal year--the government shuts down. That means [1.3 million active-duty service members won't get paid ](https://substack.com/redirect/f43aaa29-9858-481e-ad9a-fe417b69fc90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)(not including the Reserve or National Guard),[ along with](https://substack.com/redirect/96c6ffc5-1731-4964-852a-93b4df20998a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [2 million federal workers](https://substack.com/redirect/2ed6d5ad-a2c5-469a-a594-e8d04ecd4bb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The Senate needs 60 votes to pass even a short-term funding bill, which means compromise is the only way forward. But instead of pushing for it, Trump told Republicans not to deal with Democrats. On Tuesday, [Trump posted to Truth Social](https://substack.com/redirect/068d2b87-fae0-4c25-a2c0-e22b254b77cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), announcing that he had cancelled a planned meeting with Democratic leaders Sen. Schumer and Rep. Jeffries to discuss the bill, calling their demands unrealistic and accusing them of trying to tie government funding to "radical left" policies.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0160e90f-db18-4356-92bc-38c0b0611da3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
caption..From left: President Donald Trump, Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries _Getty Images_. Sourced from [CNN](https://substack.com/redirect/b37194a6-d506-4115-8950-3de8983c4358?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
This is what partisanship without principle looks like.
When leaders refuse to even sit in a room together, ordinary Americans pay the price. Soldiers overseas, families living paycheck to paycheck, federal workers keeping the trains running--none of them should be used as bargaining chips.
House Republicans passed what they call a "clean" continuing resolution (CR). It's a stopgap bill to keep the government open through November 20. It includes a few add-ons for government security and a fix for D.C.'s budget. Think of it like paying the minimum on your credit card bill: it keeps the lights on, but it doesn't solve the underlying problem.
Democrats want to use this moment to extend health care subsidies under the Affordable Care Act, which are set to expire at the end of 2025.
Republicans argue that health care is too big to tack on to a stopgap bill and should be handled later. Democrats say later is too late.
Trump, for his part, told reporters the obvious: [a shutdown may be coming.](https://substack.com/redirect/9002b7d3-4783-4bbc-bd07-2e4f24b82d91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And so here we are.
If my writing resonates with you, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..skcoVyAUObxDt1Dba0oeEmKF0RT7H_QOzvqLAig7Nqc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=174440829)
If a shutdown happens, this would be the FOURTH under Trump's watch in less than five years as President. The first three led to a record of $7.8 trillion to our national debt under President Trump's first administration (an immoral record).
**January 20 -22, 2018 (3 days)**
* Triggered by disagreements over immigration (DACA protections).
* Funding returned after bipartisan agreement, with further immigration debate pledged.

**February 9, 2018 (9 hours, overnight)**
* A very short lapse caused by a budget deal standoff in the Senate.
* Funding was restored the same day.

**December 22, 2018 - January 25, 2019 (35 days)**
* The **longest government shutdown in U.S. history**.
* Caused by Trump's demand for border wall funding ($5.7 billion) and Democrats' refusal.
* Affected about 800,000 federal workers, many of whom worked without pay.

I've tried to stay positive, to talk about unity. But I can't keep repeating "United we stand, divided we fall" when leaders in Washington won't even meet in the same room.
When I served in Iraq, I watched young soldiers wire home every cent to their families. No one gets rich serving their country. The paycheck is the bare minimum. To threaten that over political gamesmanship is unconscionable.
We need true bipartisanship. Democrats and Republicans should recognize that shutting down the government, especially at the expense of our troops, is political malpractice. The President or Congress shouldn't get paid if our troops don't.
## **The Broader Economic Picture**
Below are some compelling graphs of the U.S. economy shared in [Bruce Mehlman's Six-Chart Sunday Substack.](https://substack.com/redirect/e120c6df-702e-4f33-96f7-0b02e1acddc3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9662b6d0-eb19-476c-9664-10ccb6d5508e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/959c4073-de79-4e6f-8f0f-21980e237ff9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Markets:** Despite everything, the [S&P 500 is at an all-time high.](https://substack.com/redirect/7af936c7-8d15-4d2c-889a-ec6de688745f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Inflation:** It's up too--[2.9% this year](https://substack.com/redirect/a522fe0e-6e77-4b82-8450-a4dfb2cd31cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--while job growth has stagnated. For Gen Z grads, it's one of the worst job markets in decades.
* **Tariffs:** Trump's unilateral tariffs, imposed without congressional approval, have warped trade and stoked inflation.
* **Bankruptcies:** [Nearly 1 in 10 U.S. companies are in distress.](https://substack.com/redirect/e7cfa99f-0d43-4a3f-8a1f-1a9803efb385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Even Hallmark--yes, the company my mom singlehandedly keeps in business with her birthday and Christmas card habit--is struggling.

**National Debt:** [$37 trillion.](https://substack.com/redirect/d9674807-27ea-42c7-befc-ce1966c28739?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) That's [120% of our GDP](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3a2df9-ad3e-4418-b6f0-d050e15f74bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a higher ratio than even during WWII. Last year, we [spent $882 billion just paying interest](https://substack.com/redirect/f6633d9a-c690-4799-bf84-a6bd36f4f7bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--more than we spent on defense.
The Congressional Budget Office warns that under current policies, America's debt-to-GDP ratio will soar to unprecedented levels by 2035--higher than after the Revolutionary War, the Civil War, World War I, and the Great Influenza combined. Unless AI-driven productivity somehow rescues us, we're in uncharted territory. So far in 2025,**the federal deficit is running about 3.5% higher than the same period last year,** with **overall federal spending up nearly 7%** year-to-date, according to the [Penn Wharton Budget Model's real-time tracker](https://substack.com/redirect/fa4c425d-d1e3-4293-8929-3a9519511114?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.**
# Public Opinion
Trump's polling numbers are sinking, even in places he once carried, like my hometown of Bucks County, Pennsylvania. On immigration, on the economy, on nearly every issue, independents are breaking against him. I know polls don't vote. But local elections are being held on Nov 4, and people are paying attention.
A recent Ipsos/Washington Post poll found that a [majority of Americans disapprove of Trump's handling of nearly every major issue](https://substack.com/redirect/ea618319-e9b3-4c28-9467-e4f9160ecf5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
* **Tariffs:** 34% approve, 64% disapprove
* **Economy:** 40% approve, 59% disapprove
* **Crime:** 44% approve, 54% disapprove
* **Immigration:** 44% approve, 55% disapprove
* **Russia-Ukraine:** 38% approve, 60% disapprove ([Russia just expanded their offensive by hitting NATO member Poland with drones](https://substack.com/redirect/ab74360a-c89b-4310-a36b-6fddab3ed88f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
* **Israel-Gaza:** 39% approve, 58% disapprove

## **The Way Forward**
Basic decency demands better. Governing demands compromise and selfless leadership. And unity--like the kind Erika Kirk called for in the midst of unimaginable loss--demands that we finally remember the truth: America is stronger when we stand together, and weaker when we choose to fall apart.
We - the United States of America - are better than this. It's time for our leaders to prove it.

body:
His death was not only a personal tragedy but a deliberate attack on free speech, religious freedom, and the values that bind our Republic together.

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z1ss1jqe1sabqst7iv5d5sdqisuv0fvjesjg3itg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stj6epr2cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, On September 10, 2025, Charlie Kirk -- husband, father, and founder of Turning Point USA -- was assassinated while speaking at Utah Valley University. His death was not only a personal tragedy but a deliberate attack on free speech, religious freedom, and the values that bind our Republic together. That's why **Christian Action Network** has drafted the **Charlie Kirk Memorial Resolution** , now under review in Congress. More than 50 Members of Congress have already reached out to me about this effort -- a powerful sign that Washington is listening. It's also a reminder that Christian Action Network -- founded in 1990 and faithfully serving for over 40 years -- has built the kind of credibility and persistence that moves the needle in D.C. If passed, it will direct the Architect of the Capitol to commission and place a statue of Charlie Kirk in the U.S. Capitol Rotunda. The Rotunda is where America honors her greatest heroes -- presidents, generals, missionaries, and defenders of liberty. A statue of Charlie Kirk there would send a permanent message: violence will never silence truth. And Charlie not only _DESERVES_ to be there...he _EARNED THE RIGHT_ to be there! _But Congress will only act if it feels the pressure of the American people ... name: Nellie Pou
subject: Always fighting.
body:
I need your help.

| |
---
Hi friend, I’m not your average politician. I ran for Congress to address kitchen-table issues and deliver for New Jerseyans—not to make flashy headlines. name: Winsome
subject: A regret that would follow me for the rest of my life
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Winsome for Governor
body:
I’m writing to you today with a thought I wanted to share with you.

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgid6t79dd6ie6o3bqkgvs96fbt7ct76rrg63138_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stj69pb4cth2bs)Friend,
I'm writing to you today with a thought I wanted to share with you. As I reflect on how far we've come in this campaign, I've realized what my biggest regret would be.
I hate asking for donations; it's one of the worst parts of any campaign. But the support from you and so many patriots across the country are the key to winning this CRUCIAL race.
So the fact is, if I've realize that if we came all this way, and I could look back knowing that I could've done more, that would be my biggest regret. I know that I would always regret if I hadn't taken a chance to ask for your help when it matters most.[DONATE TODAY >>
](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmllb889khh15krjh1d2bbvrejt7hpsvkg906u90_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stj69pb4cth2bs)If I hadn't sent this email, I would regret not giving you the opportunity to stand with me against the liberal agenda that's threatening our nation. I would regret not giving you the chance to make a difference in the fight for our values, our freedom, and our Commonwealth. [So I'm asking you from the bottom of my heart, please donate any amount you can!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhgtockg6rdhfqf9ubcm6g8evkiqch14te8gaku8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stj69pb4cth2bs)[DONATE TODAY >>
](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4kbh3m4oendct5tuav1jtus0t4jkgb7ndeh8ap8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stj69pb4cth2bs)[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkojnannqh3uncolg0b4schib8q8h8e7h5odfcp0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stj69pb4cth2bs)Your support will help me continue to fight for what we believe in, and it will give us the resources we need to take on my Democrat opponent and her liberal megadonors.
I know that I'm not alone in this fight. I know that there are thousands of conservatives like you who are willing to stand up for what's right. And I know that together, we can make a real difference.

Friends, I voted NO on the bill to honor Charlie Kirk. I condemn political violence in the strongest possible terms. I also mourn with each and every one of the family members and loved ones who have suffered because of political violence, including the Kirk family. **But I cannot vote for a resolution that attempts to rewrite history and turn Charlie Kirk into something he was not.** Charlie Kirk used his platform to divide and demean -- and he was successful at it. I can't celebrate that. I will continue to work towards compromise in Congress and a better discourse in our politics. Team: As much as we wanted to stop them, Texas's new gerrymandered maps have been signed into law . Court challenges are pending.
Remember, President Trump was so scared about the upcoming midterm elections that he pressured Texas legislators into an " aggressively partisan congressional map " — and possibly five new seats in the U.S. House next year for his party.
Needless to say, this didn't need to happen. While opponents of voting rights run Texas and have for decades, their state was already extremely gerrymandered to protect their own power. These new maps aim to dilute the voting power of the state’s Black and brown voters, harming Texans around the state and making it harder for them to have their voices heard in their elections.
Whether it's Texas, or Florida, or Indiana (or California and New York) or any other state that's considering partisan gerrymanders, this constant escalation will only silence more potential voters and leave citizens less pleased with their elections and their representation.
Extreme partisan gerrymanders depress turnout and drive down voter enthusiasm for participation in our elections. Help us fight back for fair maps with $25 or whatever you can today in Texas and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=092425_1&amount=25]

President Obama said it best this week: " Over the long term, we shouldn't have political gerrymandering in America, just a fair fight between Republicans and Democrats based on who's got better ideas ."
He continued: " Texas is taking direction from a partisan White House and gerrymandering in the middle of a decade to try and maintain the House despite their unpopular policies ". This gerrymandering effort is simply a MAGA protection program.
It's also clear this is a racial gerrymander. For every 445,000 white Texans, there will be one congressional representative. That number rises for Hispanic Texans to 1.4 million residents for the same representation. For Black Texans, it takes 2 million residents for the same level of representation. Gov. Greg Abbott originally used a letter from Trump's Department of Justice to claim their previous map was racially biased in favor of Texas' Black and brown residents. He's now walking those comments back in the face of the pending legal challenges.
Fair maps and fair representation would mean those numbers were equal. Fair maps wouldn't look like a swirling vortex meant to grab *just enough* voters of certain demographics or party registration to spread them out and dilute their strength. Fair representation wouldn't be pushed through mid-decade at the request of a desperate president trying to distract from a failing economy and his involvement with an underage sex scandal.

name: Kerry McDonald
subject: Why Zuckerberg Built a Microschool for His Kids
body:
Why are tech billionaires — people with access to every elite private school in the country — choosing to build microschools for their kids?

|
---
| | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z5tennpqpv5413fa5vgg2ar844d0m0m5tnf40jgg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stgm0ob2cth2bs) Friend,

Why are tech billionaires — people with access to every elite private school in the country — choosing to build microschools for their kids?

Mark Zuckerberg. Elon Musk. Jeff Bezos. Bill Ackman. Each has invested in innovative and nontraditional schools. Some are even sending their own kids!

If our nation’s wealthiest families are creating alternatives to conventional schools, what does that tell us about the state of American education?

It tells us something most parents already know: **the system is failing — badly**.

I’m Kerry McDonald, Senior Fellow at the **Foundation for Economic Education (FEE)** , where I lead the Education Entrepreneurship Lab and host the LiberatED podcast. For years, I’ve documented the extraordinary rise of educational alternatives — microschools, learning pods, homeschooling collaboratives, and more — led not only by billionaires, but by ordinary parents and teachers determined to create something better.

body:
Hi Mr. Willis,
My name is Jackson Moran and I am an organizer with Amanda Edwards' campaign. First, I would like to say thank you so much for your support and previous help. It means a lot to have you standing with us, but we still need your help. We have a lot of work left to do.

Fellow Conservative,

They’re calling us **_“backward,” “extreme,”_** and worse — labels meant to dismiss and divide. Rep. Jasmine Crockett’s harsh words about President Trump aren’t just about him. They’re aimed at you, me, and anyone who cherishes America’s values, respects our nation’s heritage, or believes in standing firm for what’s right.

They think we’re obstacles to their agenda. They believe we’ll stay silent. But I know better — and so do you.

I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I’ve served in over 70 countries, led teams through high-stakes missions, and faced challenges that tested my resolve. Through it all, I learned that disciplined action and quiet strength always prevail.

I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota — to fight for our state with focus, humility, and unwavering commitment.

I never imagined a career in politics. But returning home from deployments, I saw a Minnesota drifting from the values that shaped me. My opponent, Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, and a radical transgender activist, pushes a far-left vision that’s out of touch with our communities. _**While chaos gripped our streets in 2020, she criticized those working to restore order, leaving businesses and families to bear the cost.**_****

I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks and enlisted in the Marine Corps at 18, weeks after 9/11. Service has always been my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. This is a different kind of fight, but the stakes are just as high.

Minnesota hasn’t backed a Republican for president since 1976, and this Senate race is an uphill climb. I’m the underdog — a regular Minnesotan called to an extraordinary challenge. **[With your support, we can turn this seat red and send a message to Washington](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=caacce7abf474ffa8b0c4d0ea884d195&_e=oevY9v8KVkdcVeWZfP0DBDByGnj8HLCmRaJ_53OiYtjzQbalVvp2wpP3_kBDUb3ZOGGrgrdb0-usdeTXPQGiDLcopF2AUFdL-EsVn8NByvkBi2gujugS4PgU4eVBD_91TbLwjSJY5ktjlOkrWkvMyisIdPCbjYC9d10n58i2K5D5Z-s73mFm3kokSjt4MWtN2wJm5aGKr37T5V_besspMA_aRUAAjpeyu60HcGfiIDrshzX4z4ZznlReLUT_fbt2f7pT4O6jUO2_bxcstuy5Ev6M7r-b1dw200ckyr2HyLFF36CHHUW97dniC-hWKKkTxPeAF4rhey5UPMtsNktq_OYN8lvA61SwwG2SmPKhW6PkSS-I7ygDBuWqiUl6zoTBDHOdHWitkagyP_MQBvHInHRE6K1bOWvzifa43-W-V53CDDEBKogf7B9wAL14ucvgvUe3F7rchsDycSDV6IJn1jAiNXNHOK-ofely2D3pbPMGvQ8HOpFVLuZ_SCgNZmQ5VeWzhi4zNunKjV974U24qQA2Tjal-W1DXL7FOgfGVMDx7T0CUNIPgRrqlW6av5P9Uh5eVrnDp5Oyutp5xFgtXEGKVnezm1HGozIKsbYeAq4Z9M5rvWLZyFFdkoHyGVBP8LDzTu8FKC7ulG9_ilxcO5tDbHCgda5v5mhouIBfeQbislXS31X1-vFrTbXOJ2lKA1mBPnbJaFNSO-vVfvEACISOGaqxQ8RiQTt5-nEXe5FqVW9rW2e7H5ybCYVQ1XEwZDgnvE_CGIUHTxYbxReMFw5OD_00LDhmEI-uM6QSGNQ%3D)**.

_**You have a choice.**_

clean_body: Tim Walz and the radical left are preparing for war - it’s up to us to stop them. As a former Navy SEAL, I believe I can be of assistance. | Fellow Conservative, They’re calling us “backward,” “extreme,” and worse — labels meant to dismiss and divide. Rep. Jasmine Crockett’s harsh words about President Trump aren’t just about him. They’re aimed at you, me, and anyone who cherishes America’s values, respects our nation’s heritage, or believes in standing firm for what’s right. They think we’re obstacles to their agenda. They believe we’ll stay silent. But I know better — and so do you. I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I’ve served in over 70 countries, led teams through high-stakes missions, and faced challenges that tested my resolve. Through it all, I learned that disciplined action and quiet strength always prevail. I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota — to fight for our state with focus, humility, and unwavering commitment. I never imagined a career in politics. But returning home from deployments, I saw a Minnesota drifting from the values that shaped me. My opponent, Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, and a radical transgender activist, pushes a far-left vision that’s out of touch with our communities. While chaos gripped our streets in 2020, she criticized those working to restore order, leaving businesses and families to bear the cost.** I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks and enlisted in the Marine Corps at 18, weeks after 9/11. Service has always been my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. This is a different kind of fight, but the stakes are just as high. Minnesota hasn’t backed a Republican for president since 1976, and this Senate race is an uphill climb. I’m the underdog — a regular Minnesotan called to an extraordinary challenge. . You have a choice. You can set this email aside, or you can join me in sending a second Navy SEAL to the U.S. Senate — someone forged in service, ready for the challenge, and driven by principle, not pride. I’ve earned degrees from Harvard and Johns Hopkins and trained in high-stakes fields like nuclear deterrence. I’ve built coalitions across cultures and led through crises. But the greatest challenge is earning your trust and building a movement to reclaim our state. I’m not asking for a free pass — I’m asking for your partnership. Our country is worth defending. Respect, integrity, and action still matter. Together, we can show Minnesota — and America — what we’re made of. Peter,

There is so much happening with the Trump administration that voters across the nation are tuning into elections earlier than ever before. November 2026 may seem like a long time away, but what we’re seeing today shows us just how critical it is to act now.

Dear Friend,
---
This is the most personal letter I’ve ever written.
---
I’m writing to you not as America’s Mayor, not as a former prosecutor, not even as President Trump’s former attorney, but as an 80-year-old man – a grandfather and a patriot – staring down a 20-year prison sentence for doing what I believed was right.
---
I’ve taken on mobsters. I’ve faced terrorists. I’ve battled corruption. I’ve been through it all.
---
_Or so I thought..._
---
**...But now, a Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
They think they’ve finally got me! Left me with no escape, no lifeline – especially after they’ve already STRIPPED me of my law licenses!
---
_No pardon.
No protection.
No cavalry coming over the hill. _
---
But even though the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful _force_ absolutely can: _THE AMERICAN PEOPLE_.
---
So, with my back against the wall, I’m turning to the one thing that can save me: **_the collective voices of MILLIONS of patriots like _YOU_._**
---
My mugshot was entered under booking #2313757, so my goal is for 2,313,757 patriots to sign my official petition — [**“THE PEOPLE’S PARDON”**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z9basgmi80l0q3h04kbtg1v594csjdc47fivt87o_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stgm4oj1c5h2bs) — calling for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES.

[**Please help me reach this life-saving (_truly!_) goal today by immediately adding your name to “THE PEOPLE’S PARDON” as citizens unite to call for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES against me.**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z6g88aj2kt98fvet5hukqn3fq2idesvbvf1b1deg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0stgm4oj1c5h2bs)

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol3b19exja4hmrvuu2xqzkih5p6xzv0po6tiwdicifitl6nrqoqdrn9678w0ksez99h173pq612jbd3v1e5emed1ue6bdkdvfewfnm28awtp2n9hhpyzwag8k82epvu903yr87f21kx8&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t33nlo&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES

NO

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
[unsubscribe](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xul=1nmc5a54x67zfmd5fi2bt1ih0jypjrzar4f7r4gbblh4mec0k0svr4ujtcltklozbp4v0tyx34l06jyfokd4nz9x2kh5zx2lrcw61285tc71h24msdjo&__stmp=t33nr8&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from our sponsor Turning Point USA.

Steve Thompson, Editor

* * *

| | | |
---
Friend, I don’t know how else to begin except with this:

** _I miss him._**

Every breath. Every heartbeat. Every memory I now replay in my mind... I miss him.

My husband, Charlie Kirk, was the love of my life.

You may know him as a fighter for freedom. A warrior for truth. The founder of Turning Point USA. The host of a nationally syndicated radio show. A bold conservative voice that gave courage to a generation.

But to me... _He was just Charlie._
---
---
He was my best friend. The father of our two precious babies. The man who made me laugh when the world felt too heavy.

The man who, every single morning without fail, would look at me and ask: _“How can I love you better today?”_

That’s who Charlie really was. _That’s who I fell in love with._

**And I want to tell you that story, Friend.**

We met at what I thought was a job interview.

Charlie messaged me in August of 2018 — very Charlie-like — short, direct, and bold:

_“Hey, I need to meet with you. Urgently.”_

I thought it was about a position with Turning Point. It wasn’t.

He took me to Bill’s Burgers in NYC. I thought I was about to be grilled for a role... and instead, I was grilled about Aristotle, theology, the Constitution, and how I saw my future.

Three and a half hours of deep conversation, and by the end of it, I still didn’t know what to think.

**Then Charlie looked at me and said:**

_**“I’m not going to hire you. I’m going to date you.”**_

I froze. I told him, “Maybe we should just be friends first.”

He didn’t skip a beat: _“I have enough friends.”_

That was Charlie.

Clarity. Conviction. A heart that always knew exactly what it wanted. And completely unshakable when he knew what was right.

God knew I needed someone who would say, “I'm not playing games. I'm not going to play with your heart. I'm a loyal person. I'm a good person. I'm a God-fearing person. I want to date you.”

**God just knew that I needed someone like that. And He said, "Here's Charlie."**

We fell fast — and we fell deep.

It wasn’t glamorous. Our lives were chaotic. Travel, pressure, early mornings, and late nights.

_But we understood each other..._

Charlie had found his mission. And I had found mine — _to stand by his side._
---
---
**He loved God. He loved me and our family. He loved America. He loved this movement.**

**Charlie also believed in you, Friend.**

He believed in the students who had never heard the truth before.

He believed in the greatness of America — even when things were dark or felt hopeless to us all.

Charlie was a father, a husband, a leader, and a warrior.

But above all, Charlie was obedient...

Obedient to God. To his conscience. To the mission placed on his heart.

**Charlie and I didn’t just build a life together — _we built a calling._**

And now...

**I don’t just bear his calling — I will lead.**

**I will lead the movement he built forward, in Charlie’s name and for God’s glory.**
---
---
Before Charlie died, he often repeated one verse more than any other:
---
_**"And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, 'Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?' Then I said, 'Here I am! Send me.'”**_ _**~ Isaiah 6:8** _
---
**Charlie answered that call every day of his life. Now, it’s my turn.**

And if you’re reading this — _maybe it’s yours, too._

We are all being called.

To serve. To love boldly. To stand. To fight for what matters.

Because Charlie’s life was not taken in vain.

The evil that tried to silence him has only made his voice louder.

We will carry the torch, Friend.

Together.

And the mission Charlie started — it will become greater than we ever imagined.

Because God is not done.

And neither are we.

With faith, love, strength, and unshakable hope...
---
---
**Erika Kirk**
CEO & Chair of the Board Turning Point USA [_**Support Turning Point USA**_](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t33nr8&__onlt=h)
---
**P.S.** Friend, you may have seen this already, but I want to share this with you anyways...

Charlie loved witnessing excellence. It’s why he loved sports so much.

He loved watching the best of the best perform at the level of greatness God intended for them.

Friend, that’s why this photo... _One of the very last photos ever taken of Charlie..._

...Took the breath right out of my chest:
---
---
Because I know that look... _**I fell in love with that look.**_

He’s in athlete mode. Locked in. Dialed. Focused.

It’s how I first met him — _driven, intense, humble, and joyful in the simplest moments._

Just Charlie. _In his element._

I remembered the early days of dating, us on a basketball court. No lights, no crowd, no noise — just the sound of sneakers on pavement.

We bonded over how Jordan was the GOAT, and he told me about his basketball days in high school and I told him about my basketball days in college.

He wore a red bracelet on his wrist that read: _**“Work harder. Be better.”**_

He never took it off. Until one day, a student came up to him after a speech and asked about it. Charlie slipped it off and gave it to them.

That was who he was. He saw greatness in others, _even when they couldn’t yet see it in themselves._

**That’s what I see in this photo — _Greatness._**

**To me, this is Charlie’s “Jordan” photo.**

_Because this was his prime..._

_Because this was Charlie at the height of everything he lived for — his purpose, his calling, his mission..._

He trained his whole life for this exact moment, the moment he’d be called home.

He gave it everything. Mind. Body. Soul.

And now, this image is permanently etched in time, held in my heart, as I admire his greatness. _Forever._

Friend, I want you to know — his mission didn’t end. It won’t ever stop...

**Because it’s alive in me. It’s alive in our children. It’s alive in the millions he’s inspired.**
****
**And if you’re reading this, I know it’s alive in you, too.**

Friend, Charlie’s life — it was so much bigger than politics...

It was about a man laying down his life, every single day, for something eternal.

And now, he’s running his race where it really counts — _where it never ends._

**Charlie, I miss you.**

I pray you’re having the most amazing time in Heaven.

And Charlie, baby, I promise I will never let your legacy slow or go silent.

I promise I'll make Turning Point USA the biggest thing that this nation has ever seen. I promise.

I love you, baby. Rest in the arms of our Lord as he blankets you with the words I know your heart _always_ strived to hear:

_**“Well done, my good and faithful servant.”**_

You lived life well. You earned it.

**And I promise...**

**I’ll carry the torch you lit from here._We’ll all carry it from here._**
---

body:
They want to silence our movement. We can’t let that happen.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250924-5463-footer&t=1&akid=5463%2E420207%2EH1wPwb)
Peter,
**One of the far right’s most extreme influencers, so-called Libs of TikTok, just went after me on social media** for doing what I’ve always done: telling the truth and giving people the tools to peacefully resist Donald Trump’s authoritarian agenda.
At a recent Resistance Lab training, I laid out the facts: Trump is taking concrete steps to eliminate opposition, silence dissent, and remake the state in his image.
**These are textbook authoritarian tactics. And they’re happening right now.**
Libs of TikTok saw the progress we’re making and wants to intimidate us out of organizing for our rights and freedoms.
The reality is the Resistance Lab has always focused on the importance of nonviolent resistance. But the irony isn’t lost on me — **Libs of TikTok is outraged because I called out far-right efforts to silence dissent, and now they’re literally trying to stop us from speaking out in defense of our democracy.**
This is _exactly_ why we launched the Resistance Labs in the first place: To train people in non-violent resistance, based on decades of research on the rise of authoritarianism, and how people-powered movements have successfully stopped it before.
Thousands of people from every state have already attended a training, so it’s no wonder the far-right is upset. They know that the more informed and organized we are, the harder it is for them to get away with their extreme power grabs.
So what do they do? They distract. They point fingers. And they try to bait us into a petty fight.
**That’s not going to work on us.** We’re not falling into their trap — we’re doubling down to expand our movement, reach more people, and continue standing up in nonviolent resistance to defend our democracy.
But I can’t do it without you. Resistance Labs are only possible because of grassroots support, and with our movement under attack, we need to stand firm — now is not the time to stop speaking out.
[**Will you rush a donation to help us continue organizing across the country and show the far right that we won’t be silent?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250924-1?refcode=em20250924-5463&refcode2=5463_420207_H1wPwb&akid=5463%2E420207%2EH1wPwb)

And if you’d like to attend an upcoming Resistance Lab, you can register **[here.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/51422?utm_source=em20250924-5463&t=2&akid=5463%2E420207%2EH1wPwb)**
Let’s continue to build this movement, defend democracy, and peacefully resist far-right extremism together.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

# **ICYMI: Nate Morris Doubles Down on Woke & Broke Record at Rubicon**

_**“I stand by everything we did 100%”**_

**Louisville, Ky. (Sept. 24, 2025) –** If you missed it, the Herald-Leader reported on Nate Morris’ failed record as a business executive. Under his watch, his company lost more than $500 million, never turned a profit, and saw its stock price collapse by 81%.

Nate’s response? He’s doubling down. In the story, he even says, “I stand by everything we did 100%.” That means he stands by pushing DEI, defending BLM riots and looting, and proudly flying the transgender flag—all while running his company into the ground.

[](https://cameronsenate.acemlnc.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE5IITPEsGuzd5GUuhw23VUudL1k-U0jqXKVqbMDX.tyEy.zOFu2o2hitU~jNY2XHj)
### **Senate candidate Nate Morris says his business, Rubicon, was a success. Was it? **
By John Cheves
Nate Morris never ran for public office until this year, so he has little in the way of a political record to share with voters.
Instead, as a Republican candidate for Kentucky’s U.S. Senate seat up for grabs in 2026, Morris sells himself as a successful business executive, the founder of a high-tech “digital waste” company called Rubicon that paid off big for all involved.
Starting in 2009, Morris — along with his partners — did indeed build a company called Rubicon Global, later Rubicon Technologies. Its software helped clients cut costs by analyzing and reducing their waste streams.
But Rubicon never made a profit during all that time.
Its stock dropped as soon as the company went public. In less than two years, the New York Stock Exchange removed Rubicon because of its valuation losses. The company suffered through layoffs, churn in the executive suites and a frequent scramble for more capital and debt refinancing.
Today, an unhappy group of early Rubicon shareholders says the company is under the control of Mexican investors who bailed it out. They are demanding more than $330 million in compensation as a result. That claim is in arbitration. Their representative declined to be interviewed for this story.
...
He exited with a compensation package worth $40.9 million and sold all his stock in the company.
...
So, was Rubicon the success that Morris claims?
Morris insists it was. He’s a millionaire thanks to Rubicon and lives with his family on a 14-acre horse farm outside Lexington that he purchased four years ago.
...
If he had to do it all over again, he wouldn’t change a thing, Morris said.
“I stand by everything we did 100%”
**Stumbling on Wall Street **
Rubicon’s biggest fumble probably was how it went public in 2022.
...
Rubicon, with Morris as CEO, went the SPAC route. It merged with an entity known as Founder SPAC and declared for itself a valuation of $1.7 billion. Unfortunately for Rubicon, not everyone agreed it was worth $1.7 billion.
...
Rubicon’s stock dropped from an opening day price of $7.55 per share to $6 by the closing bell. It kept dropping to about $1 by the time Morris resigned two months later.
In June 2024, 19 months after that, the New York Stock Exchange delisted Rubicon and suspended its share trading. The NYSE said the company’s average market capitalization fell below $15 million for 30 consecutive days.
Rubicon disputed that valuation, but it was ejected from the stock exchange.

**Read the full article from the[ __Herald Leader__](https://cameronsenate.acemlnc.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE5IITPEsGuzd5GUuhw23VUudL1k-U0jqXKVqbMDX.tyEy.zOFu2o2hitU~jNY2XHj) here.**

body:
https://maxinefororegon.com/ [https://maxinefororegon.com/]
Hi Peter,
Our service members shouldn’t be used as tools of intimidation by a coward who infamously dodged serving his country.
The president has repeatedly deployed the National Guard against the very people service members swore to protect. Our tax dollars shouldn’t fund the occupation of American cities by a president who targets communities just because they didn’t vote for him. Our neighbors and National Guard members shouldn’t be pawns in Trump’s authoritarian games.
So, Maxine Dexter co-sponsored the Safeguarding the Use of the National Guard Act , which would require the president to:
* Explain how and why he’s deploying members of the Armed Forces on American soil.
* Report on incidents of violence or threats of violence against civilians.
* Tally the total cost of deploying the National Guard to cities and ensure it won’t interfere with their ability to respond to a disaster.
We hear about it every day, how people are kidnapped off the street just because they look like someone Donald Trump doesn’t believe is American. The Supreme Court gave him the right to profile people based on their skin color, where they work, and what languages they speak.
Our service members are taken off important missions to occupy cities against the wishes of the citizens and leaders who call these cities home. We know the occupation of the Capital is having a negative impact on service members, too, because the Trump administration accidentally emailed a report to The Washington Post.

My least favorite part of running for Congress is asking for money.

body:
[unsubscribe](https://trk.trumpshowdown.com/?xul=1bu7fz54lr1j98ye80ci7qlvuvdcy2gni018bndz1puv8dvjxbyib79t0ac1ff2qnfvs33on50pgv0enhmks7vr7newnutdsara19d&__stmp=t33plv&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)

Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *
| | | |
---
Friend, I don’t know how else to begin except with this:

** _I miss him._**

Every breath. Every heartbeat. Every memory I now replay in my mind... I miss him.

My husband, Charlie Kirk, was the love of my life.

You may know him as a fighter for freedom. A warrior for truth. The founder of Turning Point USA. The host of a nationally syndicated radio show. A bold conservative voice that gave courage to a generation.

But to me... _He was just Charlie._
---
---
He was my best friend. The father of our two precious babies. The man who made me laugh when the world felt too heavy.

The man who, every single morning without fail, would look at me and ask: _“How can I love you better today?”_

That’s who Charlie really was. _That’s who I fell in love with._

**And I want to tell you that story, Friend.**

We met at what I thought was a job interview.

Charlie messaged me in August of 2018 — very Charlie-like — short, direct, and bold:

_“Hey, I need to meet with you. Urgently.”_

I thought it was about a position with Turning Point. It wasn’t.

He took me to Bill’s Burgers in NYC. I thought I was about to be grilled for a role... and instead, I was grilled about Aristotle, theology, the Constitution, and how I saw my future.

Three and a half hours of deep conversation, and by the end of it, I still didn’t know what to think.

**Then Charlie looked at me and said:**

_**“I’m not going to hire you. I’m going to date you.”**_

I froze. I told him, “Maybe we should just be friends first.”

He didn’t skip a beat: _“I have enough friends.”_

That was Charlie.

Clarity. Conviction. A heart that always knew exactly what it wanted. And completely unshakable when he knew what was right.

God knew I needed someone who would say, “I'm not playing games. I'm not going to play with your heart. I'm a loyal person. I'm a good person. I'm a God-fearing person. I want to date you.”

**God just knew that I needed someone like that. And He said, "Here's Charlie."**

We fell fast — and we fell deep.

It wasn’t glamorous. Our lives were chaotic. Travel, pressure, early mornings, and late nights.

_But we understood each other..._

Charlie had found his mission. And I had found mine — _to stand by his side._
---
---
**He loved God. He loved me and our family. He loved America. He loved this movement.**

**Charlie also believed in you, Friend.**

He believed in the students who had never heard the truth before.

He believed in the greatness of America — even when things were dark or felt hopeless to us all.

Charlie was a father, a husband, a leader, and a warrior.

But above all, Charlie was obedient...

Obedient to God. To his conscience. To the mission placed on his heart.

**Charlie and I didn’t just build a life together — _we built a calling._**

And now...

**I don’t just bear his calling — I will lead.**

**I will lead the movement he built forward, in Charlie’s name and for God’s glory.**
---
---
Before Charlie died, he often repeated one verse more than any other:
---
_**"And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, 'Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?' Then I said, 'Here I am! Send me.'”**_ _**~ Isaiah 6:8** _
---
**Charlie answered that call every day of his life. Now, it’s my turn.**

And if you’re reading this — _maybe it’s yours, too._

We are all being called.

To serve. To love boldly. To stand. To fight for what matters.

Because Charlie’s life was not taken in vain.

The evil that tried to silence him has only made his voice louder.

We will carry the torch, Friend.

Together.

And the mission Charlie started — it will become greater than we ever imagined.

Because God is not done.

And neither are we.

With faith, love, strength, and unshakable hope...
---
---
**Erika Kirk**
CEO & Chair of the Board Turning Point USA [_**Support Turning Point USA**_](https://trk.trumpshowdown.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t33plv&__onlt=h)
---
**P.S.** Friend, you may have seen this already, but I want to share this with you anyways...

Charlie loved witnessing excellence. It’s why he loved sports so much.

He loved watching the best of the best perform at the level of greatness God intended for them.

Friend, that’s why this photo... _One of the very last photos ever taken of Charlie..._

...Took the breath right out of my chest:
---
---
Because I know that look... _**I fell in love with that look.**_

He’s in athlete mode. Locked in. Dialed. Focused.

It’s how I first met him — _driven, intense, humble, and joyful in the simplest moments._

Just Charlie. _In his element._

I remembered the early days of dating, us on a basketball court. No lights, no crowd, no noise — just the sound of sneakers on pavement.

We bonded over how Jordan was the GOAT, and he told me about his basketball days in high school and I told him about my basketball days in college.

He wore a red bracelet on his wrist that read: _**“Work harder. Be better.”**_

He never took it off. Until one day, a student came up to him after a speech and asked about it. Charlie slipped it off and gave it to them.

That was who he was. He saw greatness in others, _even when they couldn’t yet see it in themselves._

**That’s what I see in this photo — _Greatness._**

**To me, this is Charlie’s “Jordan” photo.**

_Because this was his prime..._

_Because this was Charlie at the height of everything he lived for — his purpose, his calling, his mission..._

He trained his whole life for this exact moment, the moment he’d be called home.

He gave it everything. Mind. Body. Soul.

And now, this image is permanently etched in time, held in my heart, as I admire his greatness. _Forever._

Friend, I want you to know — his mission didn’t end. It won’t ever stop...

**Because it’s alive in me. It’s alive in our children. It’s alive in the millions he’s inspired.**
****
**And if you’re reading this, I know it’s alive in you, too.**

Friend, Charlie’s life — it was so much bigger than politics...

It was about a man laying down his life, every single day, for something eternal.

And now, he’s running his race where it really counts — _where it never ends._

**Charlie, I miss you.**

I pray you’re having the most amazing time in Heaven.

And Charlie, baby, I promise I will never let your legacy slow or go silent.

I promise I'll make Turning Point USA the biggest thing that this nation has ever seen. I promise.

I love you, baby. Rest in the arms of our Lord as he blankets you with the words I know your heart _always_ strived to hear:

_**“Well done, my good and faithful servant.”**_

You lived life well. You earned it.

**And I promise...**

**I’ll carry the torch you lit from here._We’ll all carry it from here._**
---

| Friends and Neighbors,

These past two months have been full of opportunities to listen, learn, and engage with our community. Today, I want to share some highlights from my work over the last several weeks. From legislative discussions to community celebrations, these moments reflect our shared commitment to making Marion County—and the rest of Florida—a better place to live, work, and thrive.

As always, please do not hesitate to [contact my office](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=3988213ce5&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| | **District Updates!**
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of speaking to members of the **Ocala Tea Party Action** group on legislation that passed during this year’s legislative session and my proposal to eliminate property taxes. Thank you to everyone who attended for your interest and support!
---
|
---
|
---
| Thank you to our **Marion County Constitutional Officers** for taking the time to have a productive discussion on property taxes and new ideas that will move our state forward.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| It was great to tour **Avante at Ocala** to learn more about their skilled nursing, rehabilitation, and post-acute services. We are grateful for their incredible work in serving the community and helping patients live life to the fullest.
---
|
---
|
---
| **The Pearl Project** does inspiring work to provide trauma-informed training and support foster, adoptive, and kinship families. I had the pleasure of meeting with members of their team to learn more about the program and how Florida can best support them.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Thank you to the**College of Central Florida** for hosting a wonderful **Legislative Thank You Brunch** for our delegation. It was a wonderful chance to connect with CF leadership, celebrate recent accomplishments, and hear about the exciting projects they have planned for the future. We are proud that CF ranks as one of the top colleges in our state!
---
|
---
---
|
---
|
---
| I had a productive meeting with the **Marion County School Board** to discuss their priorities for the upcoming legislative session and plans for our schools. Thank you to the members for taking the time to meet with me!
---
|
---
|
---
| The **Boys & Girls Club** does so much for our community, and it was great to see how their important work supports our youth. I’m proud to partner with them to help them go to the next level in serving families in need.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
---
| It was great to participate in the **Ocala CEP Healthcare Council’s Legislative Panel **with the Marion County Legislative Delegation. I had the opportunity to answer questions and have meaningful conversations about the future of healthcare in our community.
---
|
---
|
---
| We are working on several big solutions to improve Florida’s healthcare system! I had a great discussion with the **Florida Hospital Association** and leaders from Orlando hospitals about their legislative priorities for the upcoming legislative session.
---
|
---
| |
---
| I want to congratulate **Jennifer Martinez** on celebrating 10 years of incredible work at **Marion Senior Services**. Jennifer and Marion Senior Services play such a vital role in our community!
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Another fantastic meeting with the **Oak Run Republican Club**! So many folks came out, and I was excited to talk about cutting property taxes and answer questions during a great Q&A session.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| My wife Jenny and I had a great evening at the **ROCK Program’s Founders Luau**. It is always an honor to support an organization so dedicated to uplifting Marion County’s middle and high school students. Their work inspires confidence and opens doors for these young people.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Thank you to the **Transition Life Center** for giving me a tour of the facility and sharing more about the impact their services have on our community. Keep up the great work!
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
---
| It was an honor to speak on **Patriot Day** for the **Belleview Freedom Walk**. We honored the lives lost on September 11, 2001, and the heroes who risked everything that day. Patriot Day reminds us to stand united, cherish our freedoms, and never forget.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| I appreciate the **Marion County REC** for having me speak to members on property taxes. It was great to engage in some solid ideas on how to make Florida the first state in the nation where you can own your own home!
---
|
---
|
---
| I was able to enjoy a hot latte produced by the talented young entrepreneurs behind **Brew Bros** , a Belleview coffee and tea business. These guys are destined for greatness!
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
---
| What an incredible turnout at **Give4Marion**! This event highlights the strength of our community and the generosity of those who support the nonprofits working every day to serve Marion County.

Thank you to the **Community Foundation for Ocala/Marion** and all who contributed to making this year’s event such a success.
---
|
---
| Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

Tallahassee, FL 32301-2568

name: Erika Kirk, Turning Point USA
subject: Charlie answered the call. Now I will too.
body:
[Mark as Spam](http://trk.westwingdaily.com/?xul=1bu7fz64qn5caahribwjcauxkyvidgeypulzqv9ss08319l5b1k6xn3sau37yd4rl5d4z2ya6a214q83jlbu88rd5u5j807y3injb3&__stmp=t33qcr&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh) | [Unsubscribe](http://trk.westwingdaily.com/?xul=1bu7fz64qn5caahribwjcauxkyvidgeypulzqv9ss08319l5b1k6xn3sau37yd4rl5d4z2ya6a214q83jlbu88rd5u5j807y3injb3&__stmp=t33qcr&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
* * *
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *

| | | |
---
Friend, I don’t know how else to begin except with this:

** _I miss him._**

Every breath. Every heartbeat. Every memory I now replay in my mind... I miss him.

My husband, Charlie Kirk, was the love of my life.

You may know him as a fighter for freedom. A warrior for truth. The founder of Turning Point USA. The host of a nationally syndicated radio show. A bold conservative voice that gave courage to a generation.

But to me... _He was just Charlie._
---
---
He was my best friend. The father of our two precious babies. The man who made me laugh when the world felt too heavy.

The man who, every single morning without fail, would look at me and ask: _“How can I love you better today?”_

That’s who Charlie really was. _That’s who I fell in love with._

**And I want to tell you that story, Friend.**

We met at what I thought was a job interview.

Charlie messaged me in August of 2018 — very Charlie-like — short, direct, and bold:

_“Hey, I need to meet with you. Urgently.”_

I thought it was about a position with Turning Point. It wasn’t.

He took me to Bill’s Burgers in NYC. I thought I was about to be grilled for a role... and instead, I was grilled about Aristotle, theology, the Constitution, and how I saw my future.

Three and a half hours of deep conversation, and by the end of it, I still didn’t know what to think.

**Then Charlie looked at me and said:**

_**“I’m not going to hire you. I’m going to date you.”**_

I froze. I told him, “Maybe we should just be friends first.”

He didn’t skip a beat: _“I have enough friends.”_

That was Charlie.

Clarity. Conviction. A heart that always knew exactly what it wanted. And completely unshakable when he knew what was right.

God knew I needed someone who would say, “I'm not playing games. I'm not going to play with your heart. I'm a loyal person. I'm a good person. I'm a God-fearing person. I want to date you.”

**God just knew that I needed someone like that. And He said, "Here's Charlie."**

We fell fast — and we fell deep.

It wasn’t glamorous. Our lives were chaotic. Travel, pressure, early mornings, and late nights.

_But we understood each other..._

Charlie had found his mission. And I had found mine — _to stand by his side._
---
---
**He loved God. He loved me and our family. He loved America. He loved this movement.**

**Charlie also believed in you, Friend.**

He believed in the students who had never heard the truth before.

He believed in the greatness of America — even when things were dark or felt hopeless to us all.

Charlie was a father, a husband, a leader, and a warrior.

But above all, Charlie was obedient...

Obedient to God. To his conscience. To the mission placed on his heart.

**Charlie and I didn’t just build a life together — _we built a calling._**

And now...

**I don’t just bear his calling — I will lead.**

**I will lead the movement he built forward, in Charlie’s name and for God’s glory.**
---
---
Before Charlie died, he often repeated one verse more than any other:
---
_**"And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, 'Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?' Then I said, 'Here I am! Send me.'”**_ _**~ Isaiah 6:8** _
---
**Charlie answered that call every day of his life. Now, it’s my turn.**

And if you’re reading this — _maybe it’s yours, too._

We are all being called.

To serve. To love boldly. To stand. To fight for what matters.

Because Charlie’s life was not taken in vain.

The evil that tried to silence him has only made his voice louder.

We will carry the torch, Friend.

Together.

And the mission Charlie started — it will become greater than we ever imagined.

Because God is not done.

And neither are we.

With faith, love, strength, and unshakable hope...
---
---
**Erika Kirk**
CEO & Chair of the Board Turning Point USA [_**Support Turning Point USA**_](http://trk.westwingdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t33qcr&__onlt=h)
---
**P.S.** Friend, you may have seen this already, but I want to share this with you anyways...

Charlie loved witnessing excellence. It’s why he loved sports so much.

He loved watching the best of the best perform at the level of greatness God intended for them.

Friend, that’s why this photo... _One of the very last photos ever taken of Charlie..._

...Took the breath right out of my chest:
---
---
Because I know that look... _**I fell in love with that look.**_

He’s in athlete mode. Locked in. Dialed. Focused.

It’s how I first met him — _driven, intense, humble, and joyful in the simplest moments._

Just Charlie. _In his element._

I remembered the early days of dating, us on a basketball court. No lights, no crowd, no noise — just the sound of sneakers on pavement.

We bonded over how Jordan was the GOAT, and he told me about his basketball days in high school and I told him about my basketball days in college.

He wore a red bracelet on his wrist that read: _**“Work harder. Be better.”**_

He never took it off. Until one day, a student came up to him after a speech and asked about it. Charlie slipped it off and gave it to them.

That was who he was. He saw greatness in others, _even when they couldn’t yet see it in themselves._

**That’s what I see in this photo — _Greatness._**

**To me, this is Charlie’s “Jordan” photo.**

_Because this was his prime..._

_Because this was Charlie at the height of everything he lived for — his purpose, his calling, his mission..._

He trained his whole life for this exact moment, the moment he’d be called home.

He gave it everything. Mind. Body. Soul.

And now, this image is permanently etched in time, held in my heart, as I admire his greatness. _Forever._

Friend, I want you to know — his mission didn’t end. It won’t ever stop...

**Because it’s alive in me. It’s alive in our children. It’s alive in the millions he’s inspired.**
****
**And if you’re reading this, I know it’s alive in you, too.**

Friend, Charlie’s life — it was so much bigger than politics...

It was about a man laying down his life, every single day, for something eternal.

And now, he’s running his race where it really counts — _where it never ends._

**Charlie, I miss you.**

I pray you’re having the most amazing time in Heaven.

And Charlie, baby, I promise I will never let your legacy slow or go silent.

I promise I'll make Turning Point USA the biggest thing that this nation has ever seen. I promise.

I love you, baby. Rest in the arms of our Lord as he blankets you with the words I know your heart _always_ strived to hear:

_**“Well done, my good and faithful servant.”**_

You lived life well. You earned it.

**And I promise...**

**I’ll carry the torch you lit from here._We’ll all carry it from here._**
---
