name: Erika Kirk, Turning Point USA
subject: God wrote our love story.
body:
[Unsubscribe](http://trk.conservativereboot.com/?xul=zkl8p045sz1uh88qpcsbcn9qhzu1ukdso0t7dtcrfhfkbeoyq2n5fdyjonxtfinlenmnlej47nscxfwg9wj7wwxndrscs3zbi8opf2ft3j4pm&__stmp=t33qml&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *

| | | |
---
Friend, I don’t know how else to begin except with this:

** _I miss him._**

Every breath. Every heartbeat. Every memory I now replay in my mind... I miss him.

My husband, Charlie Kirk, was the love of my life.

You may know him as a fighter for freedom. A warrior for truth. The founder of Turning Point USA. The host of a nationally syndicated radio show. A bold conservative voice that gave courage to a generation.

But to me... _He was just Charlie._
---
---
He was my best friend. The father of our two precious babies. The man who made me laugh when the world felt too heavy.

The man who, every single morning without fail, would look at me and ask: _“How can I love you better today?”_

That’s who Charlie really was. _That’s who I fell in love with._

**And I want to tell you that story, Friend.**

We met at what I thought was a job interview.

Charlie messaged me in August of 2018 — very Charlie-like — short, direct, and bold:

_“Hey, I need to meet with you. Urgently.”_

I thought it was about a position with Turning Point. It wasn’t.

He took me to Bill’s Burgers in NYC. I thought I was about to be grilled for a role... and instead, I was grilled about Aristotle, theology, the Constitution, and how I saw my future.

Three and a half hours of deep conversation, and by the end of it, I still didn’t know what to think.

**Then Charlie looked at me and said:**

_**“I’m not going to hire you. I’m going to date you.”**_

I froze. I told him, “Maybe we should just be friends first.”

He didn’t skip a beat: _“I have enough friends.”_

That was Charlie.

Clarity. Conviction. A heart that always knew exactly what it wanted. And completely unshakable when he knew what was right.

God knew I needed someone who would say, “I'm not playing games. I'm not going to play with your heart. I'm a loyal person. I'm a good person. I'm a God-fearing person. I want to date you.”

**God just knew that I needed someone like that. And He said, "Here's Charlie."**

We fell fast — and we fell deep.

It wasn’t glamorous. Our lives were chaotic. Travel, pressure, early mornings, and late nights.

_But we understood each other..._

Charlie had found his mission. And I had found mine — _to stand by his side._
---
---
**He loved God. He loved me and our family. He loved America. He loved this movement.**

**Charlie also believed in you, Friend.**

He believed in the students who had never heard the truth before.

He believed in the greatness of America — even when things were dark or felt hopeless to us all.

Charlie was a father, a husband, a leader, and a warrior.

But above all, Charlie was obedient...

Obedient to God. To his conscience. To the mission placed on his heart.

**Charlie and I didn’t just build a life together — _we built a calling._**

And now...

**I don’t just bear his calling — I will lead.**

**I will lead the movement he built forward, in Charlie’s name and for God’s glory.**
---
---
Before Charlie died, he often repeated one verse more than any other:
---
_**"And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, 'Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?' Then I said, 'Here I am! Send me.'”**_ _**~ Isaiah 6:8** _
---
**Charlie answered that call every day of his life. Now, it’s my turn.**

And if you’re reading this — _maybe it’s yours, too._

We are all being called.

To serve. To love boldly. To stand. To fight for what matters.

Because Charlie’s life was not taken in vain.

The evil that tried to silence him has only made his voice louder.

We will carry the torch, Friend.

Together.

And the mission Charlie started — it will become greater than we ever imagined.

Because God is not done.

And neither are we.

With faith, love, strength, and unshakable hope...
---
---
**Erika Kirk**
CEO & Chair of the Board Turning Point USA [_**Support Turning Point USA**_](http://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t33qml&__onlt=h)
---
**P.S.** Friend, you may have seen this already, but I want to share this with you anyways...

Charlie loved witnessing excellence. It’s why he loved sports so much.

He loved watching the best of the best perform at the level of greatness God intended for them.

Friend, that’s why this photo... _One of the very last photos ever taken of Charlie..._

...Took the breath right out of my chest:
---
---
Because I know that look... _**I fell in love with that look.**_

He’s in athlete mode. Locked in. Dialed. Focused.

It’s how I first met him — _driven, intense, humble, and joyful in the simplest moments._

Just Charlie. _In his element._

I remembered the early days of dating, us on a basketball court. No lights, no crowd, no noise — just the sound of sneakers on pavement.

We bonded over how Jordan was the GOAT, and he told me about his basketball days in high school and I told him about my basketball days in college.

He wore a red bracelet on his wrist that read: _**“Work harder. Be better.”**_

He never took it off. Until one day, a student came up to him after a speech and asked about it. Charlie slipped it off and gave it to them.

That was who he was. He saw greatness in others, _even when they couldn’t yet see it in themselves._

**That’s what I see in this photo — _Greatness._**

**To me, this is Charlie’s “Jordan” photo.**

_Because this was his prime..._

_Because this was Charlie at the height of everything he lived for — his purpose, his calling, his mission..._

He trained his whole life for this exact moment, the moment he’d be called home.

He gave it everything. Mind. Body. Soul.

And now, this image is permanently etched in time, held in my heart, as I admire his greatness. _Forever._

Friend, I want you to know — his mission didn’t end. It won’t ever stop...

**Because it’s alive in me. It’s alive in our children. It’s alive in the millions he’s inspired.**
****
**And if you’re reading this, I know it’s alive in you, too.**

Friend, Charlie’s life — it was so much bigger than politics...

It was about a man laying down his life, every single day, for something eternal.

And now, he’s running his race where it really counts — _where it never ends._

**Charlie, I miss you.**

I pray you’re having the most amazing time in Heaven.

And Charlie, baby, I promise I will never let your legacy slow or go silent.

I promise I'll make Turning Point USA the biggest thing that this nation has ever seen. I promise.

I love you, baby. Rest in the arms of our Lord as he blankets you with the words I know your heart _always_ strived to hear:

_**“Well done, my good and faithful servant.”**_

You lived life well. You earned it.

**And I promise...**

**I’ll carry the torch you lit from here._We’ll all carry it from here._**
---

Last week, on Constitution Day, I filed to run for reelection. Since the first time I ran for office back in 2017 to this week, I’ve weighed carefully and taken seriously the decision to ask my community to put your faith in me. But something about this moment in our nation makes my responsibility feel particularly heavy.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-sefc-q3-2025-em?refcode=blu_em_sefc_2025-09-24 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-sefc-q3-2025-em?refcode=blu_em_sefc_2025-09-24]
I chose to file for reelection on Constitution Day because our country is at a critical inflection point. Every day we are seeing this Administration whittle away core principles of our Constitution – due process, free expression, and the responsibilities of checks and balances enshrined to Congress in Article 1. As someone who taught Political Science 101 for six years in a college classroom, I know what our Framers were protecting against – and what they were fighting for – when they created a House of Representatives directly elected every two years by the American people.
When we take back the majority in 2026, my Democratic colleagues and I will work together to ensure that Congress reassert its role as a coequal branch of government and protect these fundamental rights.
There’s a lot of work ahead, but I'm committed to doing it. Are you with me? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-sefc-q3-2025-em?refcode=blu_em_sefc_2025-09-24]

| Peter,
As more and more geriatric politicians turn senile in office, term limits for elected officials have become an increasingly popular policy position amongst progressives and conservatives alike.
Recognizing this, GOP strategists have weaponized this sentiment and are using it to trick voters into voting for a far-right cause in an important upcoming election:
The November 2025 Pennsylvania Supreme Court Election.
Though a state Supreme Court Race may sound boring and parochial the stakes of this race are anything but. If Democrats lose here we stand to permanently lose key swing state Pennsylvania for the next decade and beyond - 19 electoral college votes squandered.
Which is why the GOP is catfishing and pulling out all the dirty tricks to win this race:

Voters need to know the truth of what's at stake in this election but with only 42 days left and MAGA flooding the state with millions in dark money we are running out of time and money to counter their disinformation.

subject: This isn’t easy to share
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep25.vnrwKJ&refcode=em250924-1A-b&t=1&akid=10902%2E3935704%2EFD3fDW)
Team --
I still remember the day vividly. It was January 8, 2011.
I was holding a constituent meeting for the Tucson, Arizona community, which I represented as a Congresswoman. A gunman suddenly opened fire with a semi-automatic weapon, shooting me in the head.
He then turned on my constituents, shooting 18 people. Six innocent lives were lost in the attack:
Christina-Taylor Green.
Phyllis Schneck.
Gabe Zimmerman.
Dorwan Stoddard.
Dorothy Morris.
Judge John Roll.
I will carry their memories with me now and forever.
Remembering this shooting is always painful for me and the community I call home. But it is a reminder of the important work we do and why we move forward.
When I had to step down from my office as Representative to focus on my recovery, I never stepped away from my life’s purpose: working to make my community and my country better. I was working to get better, and thinking about how, in a new capacity as a private citizen, I could contribute. And after the Sandy Hook shooting which killed 26 people including 20 children, I knew the time had come for a big move.
It’s not easy to stand up when others tell you to be quiet — especially when you are wrestling with the pain and trauma that gun violence leaves in its wake.
And that is why I am grateful for the opportunity to work with our team at GIFFORDS, to make lifesaving efforts and fight back against the gun lobby.
Success is only possible if we’re in this together, just like my recovery was only possible because loved ones and members of my community stepped up to help me in the darkest moment of my life.
This has been a long haul. It was always going to be that way. But I’m optimistic that if we keep moving forward, we will save lives and emerge victorious.
Thank you for standing with me in the fight.
All my best,
Gabby Giffords

Gabby Giffords has been leading the fight to stop gun violence for more than a decade, but she can’t do it alone.

Here’s what my billionaire opponent recently said about me, Peter:
**“She’s a school teacher. What does she know about running anything?”**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250924_1_ak?refcode=em20250924-40184&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=40184_3422442_F_xvvk&akid=40184%2E3422442%2EF_xvvk)
I’m not insulted that the guy attacked me–after cutting a $10 million check to his own campaign no less!
**But it really bothers me to hear yet another politician belittle the work teachers all across California do.**
From running a classroom and after-school activities, to running parent-teacher conferences and PTA meetings, **teachers know a hell of a lot more about what’s going on with California families than this guy does.**
Our next governor should be someone who understands the challenges families face and is ready to take them on.
**I’ve taken on powerful interests throughout my career in public service.** I took on the Big Banks in the wake of the mortgage foreclosure crisis and held the Trump Administration accountable as a Member of Congress.
Our next Governor has to take on our affordability crisis and make it easier for California teachers, _and everyone_ , to live here. From home prices to groceries, everything here is too expensive and I feel it too.
**My opponent may think “a school teacher” isn’t up for the job–but we know that’s _exactly_ the kind of leader California needs.**
**But to win against someone who can pour tens of millions into his campaign, I’m going to need your help.**

Friend, I don't even know how to begin to put into words the loss I am feeling... but this isn't about me. **Today, tomorrow, next week -- they're all about Charlie. ** Because Charlie was truly one of the best men I'll ever know. He changed the direction of this nation. He was a leader, a fighter, and a man whose character and conviction were rare. Too rare. He was an inspiration to millions around the world. **To me, Charlie was a little brother.** That honor I will carry with me forever.

I'm heartbroken knowing his death will leave a hole in the heart of our nation.... and an even larger one in my life. Charlie may no longer stand beside me -- to remind me to push on when things get tough. _But his memory will._ _And I 'll make sure it does for this country he loved so well._ Charlie led a life of courage, strength, and conviction. **Now it 's time for me, for you, and for every patriot to stand up and fight for everything Charlie stood for. ** He poured every ounce of energy he had into saving this nation -- and he did that through Turning Point USA. No one fought harder than Charlie. It was his mission in life to give people the courage to speak up -- and he did that. And none of us will ever be silenced again. He fought for you and all America. Now we must fight for him. **Friend, it 's on us to keep his life's work alive...** so it can continue to reach young people, change lives, and embolden the American people. **As his friend, I ask that you help me make certain that Charlie 's voice is never silenced, stopped, or forgotten.** That it's heard across the nation... in every church, in every school, and in every home for generations. _Let 's make the world remember him._ **[Friend, the only way to do that is to make Turning Point USA the biggest thing America has ever seen... because Charlie’s legacy doesn’t end here.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=50e78ff51a5d45899e4319d6eb61d106&_e=uhIZdMWvrabU9CySIdu2MjLAnZZUT-fQVJk7pmImHT63bQh72LQS8kB2CtWV5Ud_0Vqk8ToGb29oDvSyVXocw7u_AxN-MzY9EJ3bXgjsr9FOza4SBOEdH-WJmB5vh5RJk7gl0a29BydZGSMiPNFZVcOZY-nC62gOB7ugso9b8TvyJStlK-YSb8I6OyBqjrXYbTKIYdP7wkd0h_IpGoUxn8Jbu24rlU3JlRhPA0XUC-NPHAbGGRBdjjoN-q36SYAdNMhz3OzswJfNHSes0DpCQ3H0PlV-OQ_nSHeMtXC042YIf7jYeSaVB_n6_tTNVVeaBT4u4H4v9LTuapcIhZO_niRL1KWC_Pd9eg46gpi0EWzuYzEcxP49kCLWitrW_Gioae5HEhAZZEk9Amz1i5tkwQxr9k1CudaaKf4UWBVUCcR3c9H8sAvjDg7EbyLf83oTdWcwPN5eJL2wBscU9X6C4UGKukIBzQGBq-cXL4YhKshHuYHUjHQ9us3znlkXQFsiSksze83S2RQfxln272faouwNQ59jUjAf4VshnW-teIyyMLGv6Zz5z-hehKNN0t8FFn2d5owZh3Bh8AjpC32M7mER8viQEV8WO5OBHeBu5Owu6liUF5wJI7v7dOdQDzsmTc47bxDxx1Ab3hIk7uToy0sZNH8PbpP60RtZBemjMjwKoP6fjaCly0Hyuvkt3JqjYFSsSghzzMOESSj0DC99XEl02hWRUs-NGbpwujOOWeM%3D)**

That honor I will carry with me forever. I'm heartbroken knowing his death will leave a hole in the heart of our nation.... and an even larger one in my life. Charlie may no longer stand beside me -- to remind me to push on when things get tough. But his memory will. And I 'll make sure it does for this country he loved so well. Charlie led a life of courage, strength, and conviction. Now it 's time for me, for you, and for every patriot to stand up and fight for everything Charlie stood for. As his friend, I ask that you help me make certain that Charlie 's voice is never silenced, stopped, or forgotten. body:
As you know, there will be a special election in California in just a few short weeks.
We didn’t expect to have an election this fall, and certainly didn’t expect to be voting on mid-term redistricting, but these aren’t normal times and this isn’t politics as usual.
Trump changed all the rules when he demanded Texas and other Republican states redraw districts in an attempt to steal control of Congress. We can’t sit by and let this happen without a fight.
I hope you will stand with me and support Prop 50.

It is important to note there are some key differences between Prop 50 and what other states are doing.
* Prop 50 gives voters the choice to approve these emergency redistricting measures
* It is on the ballot ONLY because other states moved ahead with their power grabs
* Prop 50 is TEMPORARY. The new maps would expire in 2030 and the independent redistricting commission will once again be responsible for drawing congressional maps
While Prop 50 is important, it is only one tool to help elect Democrats in 2026. We must also continue to raise money, run strong campaigns and turn out voters.

Fellow Conservative,

They’re calling us **_“backward,” “extreme,”_** and worse — labels meant to dismiss and divide. Rep. Jasmine Crockett’s harsh words about President Trump aren’t just about him. They’re aimed at you, me, and anyone who cherishes America’s values, respects our nation’s heritage, or believes in standing firm for what’s right.

They think we’re obstacles to their agenda. They believe we’ll stay silent. But I know better — and so do you.

I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I’ve served in over 70 countries, led teams through high-stakes missions, and faced challenges that tested my resolve. Through it all, I learned that disciplined action and quiet strength always prevail.

I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota — to fight for our state with focus, humility, and unwavering commitment.

I never imagined a career in politics. But returning home from deployments, I saw a Minnesota drifting from the values that shaped me. My opponent, Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, and a radical transgender activist, pushes a far-left vision that’s out of touch with our communities. _**While chaos gripped our streets in 2020, she criticized those working to restore order, leaving businesses and families to bear the cost.**_****

I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks and enlisted in the Marine Corps at 18, weeks after 9/11. Service has always been my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. This is a different kind of fight, but the stakes are just as high.

Minnesota hasn’t backed a Republican for president since 1976, and this Senate race is an uphill climb. ABC may have brought Jimmy Kimmel back, but this fight is far from over. Two of the largest media corporations in the country, Sinclair and Nexstar, are still refusing to broadcast Jimmy’s show. Together, they control nearly a quarter of the nation’s television market, which means millions of Americans are being denied the right to watch him simply because he dared to speak his mind. But before I do, if you’re like me and are done with the BS coming from Washington, please split a contribution between Lt. Gov. Austin Davis and my campaign now.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115850485/571672171/1933650748?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_092325_McMorrow_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzNiZjA5Yy03NDk5LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kPLPrp9Mmyjka-0rpj7_Y1SxsXM_V15unO7pta3ROKE=) Now I want to tell you a story. I never thought I’d be in politics. But after the 2016 election, like a lot of us, I was fed up. Politics should be about service, not self-interest. And not building up your own power by tearing others down. So I googled _“how to run for office.”_ Seriously. I took on a state Senate race in Michigan no one thought we could win. I took on an incumbent state Senator who _refused_ to do anything about the epidemic of gun violence, who sided with corporate polluters over protecting our clean water, and who didn’t represent us. Democrats and Republicans counted me out because I was young. Because I had never run for office before. Because it _**“wasn’t my turn.”**_ But through the help of over 500(!) local volunteers, I swung a Republican-held state Senate seat 20 points and flipped a district that included Mitt Romney’s hometown. That victory sent me to the Michigan State Senate. **[My approach in the Michigan State Senate is the same approach I’ll take in the U.S. Senate: no bullshit.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115850488/571672174/1933650748?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_092325_McMorrow_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzNiZjA5Yy03NDk5LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kPLPrp9Mmyjka-0rpj7_Y1SxsXM_V15unO7pta3ROKE=)** The system is broken, and we should call it out. I’m a millennial. On the whole, we’re the first generation to do worse than our parents. For millions of people, it can feel like you’ve done _everything_ right — working hard in school, going to college or earning a skill or trade, taking on one job, then a side-hustle, then a gig, building your entire life around work and still barely getting by. It’s impossible to buy a house. It’s too expensive to start a family. We look at our parents and wonder where it all went wrong? The American Dream feels like a distant past. Democratic messaging usually sounds something like this: “Democrats are fighting to help you put food on the table.” Oy. Now look, of _course_ that’s true, but that vision isn’t big enough. _No one_ aspires to _just get by._ We need to think bigger, dream bigger, and lay out a vision for the New American Dream that people can see themselves in, something they want to vote _for._ Because being against Donald Trump is simply not enough. It’s about a Michigan where you know you’ll have a tight-knit, vibrant community, where you’ll have restaurants, small businesses, and places to go. It’s about creating a future where if you work hard, you _will_ be able to afford the life you dreamed of — to start a family, to buy that house, rent where you want, have the car you want, have a fulfilling career, and yes — maybe even have that little place Up North because you can afford a vacation and time away to reset. And still put money away for retirement, savings, or a college or house fund for your kids. **[Democrats have to get real. The status quo simply wasn’t working. But while Donald Trump and Elon Musk want to burn it all to the ground, we have to build something new. Something that actually _works._ For _everyone._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115850490/571672178/1933650748?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_092325_McMorrow_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzNiZjA5Yy03NDk5LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kPLPrp9Mmyjka-0rpj7_Y1SxsXM_V15unO7pta3ROKE=)** I’m fed up with Democrats in DC who have completely missed how much people were struggling. I’m fed up with the party of “Well, _actually_.” When we told our party leaders that groceries and gas were too expensive, that people were struggling to find the job they really wanted, that they felt stretched too thin, what did Democrats do? Told them the economy was doing great, _actually._ So yes, even if the decisions made by our leaders staved off the worst of a recession, people were still hurting. And we need to _listen_ to them. Voters know BS. I’ve called BS out in the State Senate, and that’s what I’ll do as U.S. Senator. **[If you’re done with the same old nonsense, split a donation between Lt. Gov. Austin Davis and my campaign and send a message to DC.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115850492/571672179/1933650748?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_092325_McMorrow_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzNiZjA5Yy03NDk5LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kPLPrp9Mmyjka-0rpj7_Y1SxsXM_V15unO7pta3ROKE=)** Right now, we’re at a crossroads. Donald Trump and Elon Musk are trying to overwhelm us. That’s their plan; they want us to feel powerless. **But we are not powerless.** The reality is, there’s a lot in common between this moment today and that moment in 2016 when I googled how to run for office. But what that means is that we know _exactly_ how to rise to this moment. This is not a moment for weakness. This is the time to put our heads down and get to work. That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. This moment, and what happens next, is on all of us. I will never try to convince you that I have all the answers. Just voting for the right person isn’t going to fix everything. But together, I know we can show Michigan — and the rest of the country — how powerful we really are. Let’s create the future we want to see, together. **[So please join us in building that future: split a contribution of whatever you can between Lt. Gov. Austin Davis and my campaign for U.S. Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115850493/571672181/1933650748?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_092325_McMorrow_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzNiZjA5Yy03NDk5LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kPLPrp9Mmyjka-0rpj7_Y1SxsXM_V15unO7pta3ROKE=)** | | **[JOIN US](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115850495/571672182/1933650748?amount=10&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_092325_McMorrow_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzNiZjA5Yy03NDk5LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kPLPrp9Mmyjka-0rpj7_Y1SxsXM_V15unO7pta3ROKE=)**

If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | = I'm Mallory McMorrow, and I'm running for the U.S. Senate. Point blank, we need new leaders in Washington who will call out the bullshit. = Now I want to tell you a story. I never thought I’d be in politics. But after the 2016 election, like a lot of us, I was fed up. Politics should be about service, not self-interest. And not building up your own power by tearing others down. So I googled “how to run for office.” Seriously. I took on a state Senate race in Michigan no one thought we could win. I took on an incumbent state Senator who refused to do anything about the epidemic of gun violence, who sided with corporate polluters over protecting our clean water, and who didn’t represent us. Democrats and Republicans counted me out because I was young. Because I had never run for office before. Because it “wasn’t my turn.” But through the help of over 500(!) local volunteers, I swung a Republican-held state Senate seat 20 points and flipped a district that included Mitt Romney’s hometown. That victory sent me to the Michigan State Senate. = The system is broken, and we should call it out. I’m a millennial. On the whole, we’re the first generation to do worse than our parents. For millions of people, it can feel like you’ve done everything right — working hard in school, going to college or earning a skill or trade, taking on one job, then a side-hustle, then a gig, building your entire life around work and still barely getting by. It’s impossible to buy a house. It’s too expensive to start a family. We look at our parents and wonder where it all went wrong? The American Dream feels like a distant past. Democratic messaging usually sounds something like this: “Democrats are fighting to help you put food on the table.” Oy. Now look, of course that’s true, but that vision isn’t big enough. No one aspires to just get by. We need to think bigger, dream bigger, and lay out a vision for the New American Dream that people can see themselves in, something they want to vote for. Because being against Donald Trump is simply not enough. It’s about a Michigan where you know you’ll have a tight-knit, vibrant community, where you’ll have restaurants, small businesses, and places to go. It’s about creating a future where if you work hard, you will be able to afford the life you dreamed of — to start a family, to buy that house, rent where you want, have the car you want, have a fulfilling career, and yes — maybe even have that little place Up North because you can afford a vacation and time away to reset. And still put money away for retirement, savings, or a college or house fund for your kids. = I’m fed up with Democrats in DC who have completely missed how much people were struggling. I’m fed up with the party of “Well, actually.” When we told our party leaders that groceries and gas were too expensive, that people were struggling to find the job they really wanted, that they felt stretched too thin, what did Democrats do? Told them the economy was doing great, actually. So yes, even if the decisions made by our leaders staved off the worst of a recession, people were still hurting. And we need to listen to them. Voters know BS. I’ve called BS out in the State Senate, and that’s what I’ll do as U.S. Senator. = Right now, we’re at a crossroads. Donald Trump and Elon Musk are trying to overwhelm us. That’s their plan; they want us to feel powerless. But we are not powerless. The reality is, there’s a lot in common between this moment today and that moment in 2016 when I googled how to run for office. But what that means is that we know exactly how to rise to this moment. This is not a moment for weakness. This is the time to put our heads down and get to work. That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. This moment, and what happens next, is on all of us. I will never try to convince you that I have all the answers. Just voting for the right person isn’t going to fix everything. But together, I know we can show Michigan — and the rest of the country — how powerful we really are. The Latino Vote Podcast Season 2025 Episode 31

subject: The Mountain Minute: 9/24/2025
body:
Has AI Begun Transforming Employment in the Colorado Legal Services Industry?
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
🎙️ Check out today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Evergreen High students are [returning in phases](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after last week’s shooting, balancing grief with hope for recovery. The state Supreme Court is reviewing whether officials wrongly blocked journalists from [child abuse hotline data](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), raising transparency concerns. Meanwhile, TABOR’s growth cap leaves a [$850 million budget gap](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), forcing deep cuts by Governor Polis, as the [prison population climbs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the first time in years—hailed by some as restoring law and order despite reform pushback.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** Conservatives are intensifying cultural and political fights. The [1776 Project PAC](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is targeting teachers who celebrated Charlie Kirk’s assassination, calling them unfit for classrooms. In Texas, parents linked to Democrats pressured schools to [block a student Turning Point USA chapter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), sparking backlash over free speech. At the same time, President Trump and HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. tied [Tylenol in pregnancy to autism risk](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) while promoting leucovorin as a treatment, igniting debate over health transparency. And in media, Sinclair Broadcasting is [refusing to air Jimmy Kimmel’s late-night show](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) across its ABC affiliates despite Disney announcing its return.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** This week’s commentary examines water, work, and Colorado’s future. ELISE STEFANIK Peter, September 30th is the FINAL FEC-mandated end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day. That means it’s our LAST CHANCE to raise vital funds we need to STOP communist Democrat Zohran Mamdani from becoming the next mayor of New York. As New York’s Senior elected Republican, I’m fighting with every fiber of my being to save our state’s largest city, including launching an unprecedented city-wide GOTV effort. Per Politico : “New York City Republican voters are going to be hearing from Rep. Elise Stefanik. The potential gubernatorial candidate is the face of a get-out-the-vote effort for Big Apple Republicans... Stefanik and the New York GOP are targeting Republican voters who turned out in the 2024 presidential election, but have not cast ballots in mayoral elections.” However, I’ll be perfectly honest with you, Peter... If we don’t reach this critical goal, we’ll lack the funds we need to keep our operation running all the way through Election Day (and beyond as ballots are counted). That is why I’m officially launching our end-of-quarter fundraising push earlier than ever before with an ambitious target of 1,000,000 NEW grassroots contributions before September 30th. And given the scale of the threat we face, we need contributions from not just New York, but from all over the country. That is why I’ve also set an ambitious goal of securing a contribution from every single zip code in the United States of America to SAVE the largest city in America. You see, while it may be easy to dismiss this as a problem for New York alone, that couldn’t be further from the truth. The consequences of a Mamdani victory will not be limited to New York. The rise of Zohran Mamdani bears a lot of similarity to the rise of a radical young community organizer from Chicago named Barack Obama. In fact, many are already calling Zohran Mamdani “the next Obama,” and Obama has even called Mamdani to offer his advice and support! Knowing what you know now, if you had the chance to destroy Obama’s political career before he rose to national prominence, wouldn’t you do everything in your power to do so? Well, this is our chance to STOP the next Obama! Thank you, Rep. Dear Friend, I was planning to write and tell you all about our incredible August 16th **SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY** **DAY** event at the Library of Congress to counter the Left’s “Drag Queen Story Hours.”But then the reports started coming in from parents and grandparents across the country about the opposition they faced at their **SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY** events. Friend, I know the mainstream media won’t spend a second telling you what happened so I will.In Cuyahoga, OH, protestors formed an intimidating gauntlet at the entrance to the public library. Parents had to shepherd their children through it as if they were criminals just to get into our event. Then inside, while BRAVE families were hearing books about Godly virtues, protestors held up their own inappropriate books showing pornographic content, including one depicting sexual acts between two men.In Highlands Ranch, CO, a group of grandparents invited a local deputy to read the BRAVE book, _The Test of Lionhood_ which teaches children the importance of courage, perseverance and masculinity. When the unhinged atheists at the _Freedom from Religion Foundation_ got wind of the grandparents’ effort to share these virtues with Colorado children, they fired off a threatening letter to the Sheriff’s Department.

Can I let you in on a secret about me? I am a HUGE classic rock fan.

I admit it — whether it’s the Stones, Bon Jovi, or Billy Joel, I’m IN.

When I served as a House Impeachment Manager during Donald Trump’s first impeachment trial, I had Billy Joel’s “Keeping the Faith” on repeat.

These days, it may feel more challenging than ever to keep the faith.

Donald Trump and his Republican allies in Congress are ripping away health care and food assistance from working Americans to serve their ultra-wealthy buddies, they're shamelessly separating families and deporting people without due process, and they're too busy playing party politics to sit down and actually listen to people.

### Western man must choose his path
| | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
| Sep 24
---
| [](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---

---

This morning at an ICE facility in Texas, an attacker shot three people before turning the gun on himself. This was a calculated assault on the institutions that protect our borders and maintain civilizational order.
The smell of gunpowder still hangs in the air.
The blood is still being mopped up, and the message is crystal clear:_**** they'll kill anyone who stands for Western civilization._
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1e3f502d-f6b2-4877-90d0-dca4151a9eb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Because Western civilization IS Christianity.
And every cultural norm we take for granted flows from it. Our concept of individual human dignity? Christianity teaches that every person bears God's image. Our legal system based on equal justice? Rooted in biblical law. Those hospitals where your children are born, those universities where they (used to) learn, those charities that feed the hungry? All born from Christian compassion.
In fact, all nations touched by Christian influence developed human rights, abolished slavery, educated the masses, and lifted entire populations from poverty. While nations that destroyed Christianity gave us Soviet gulags, Nazi death camps, Chinese labor camps, North Korean tyranny.
The pattern is unmistakable: Christianity liberates. Its absence enslaves.
Cameron Higby just learned this the hard way.
All he did was set up a table on campus, following Charlie Kirk's example of engaging students in conversation. Within minutes, a mob of students surrounded him, screaming, threatening, chasing him off campus.
Watch the video. Look at their faces. Listen to their voices.
This is what pure hatred looks like:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/14f182ea-7fb4-488c-84a5-0e686e2b9af9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meanwhile, in Dearborn, Michigan, the masks came off completely.
Islamists march through American streets chanting "Death to America" while Representative Rashida Tlaib refuses to condemn such displays of hatred toward the nation that welcomed them.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8e26494a-6c59-49a4-92a2-1d102992f59a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Those scenes look like something from a majority Muslim country because that's exactly what they're trying to create. This is conquest, not "immigration."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f54ad533-a78f-45df-9723-3be4156fcb76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## Why They Killed Charlie Kirk
Charlie Kirk represented everything they despise about Western civilization.
He stood for:
* Marriage as a covenant between one man and one woman...
* Children as blessings, not burdens...
* The unborn as bearers of divine image deserving protection...
* The nuclear family as civilization's foundation...
* National sovereignty, law and order...
* The right to speak truth without fear...

For speaking these truths, they murdered him in cold blood.
As Jesus himself warned his followers in John 15:18-25: _**" If the world hates you, know that it has hated me before it hated you... If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you."**_
They killed Jesus.
Did you think they'd spare his followers?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/be72c07e-0ff9-4508-a350-409ce928cd90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## The Battle Lines Are Drawn
This spiritual war manifests everywhere you look (as Andrew Breitbart said, "Politics is downstream from culture.").
On college campuses, Christian students are chased away by mobs for wanting conversation. In our cities, Islamists chant "Death to America" in the streets. At our borders, attackers assault immigration enforcement facilities. And in our culture, they're trying to systematically destroy marriage, family, and the sanctity of life.
So when leftists say they hate Western culture, they're being remarkably honest.
They hate Christianity. They hate the civilization it built. They hate the people who defend it, and they're willing to kill to destroy it.
The questions facing every Western person today cut to the bone:
1. _Will you defend the Christian foundations that built our civilization, or will you surrender them to forces that openly despise everything we 've inherited?_
2. _Will you stand with Charlie Kirk 's legacy, or will you let his blood be spilled in vain?_
3. _Will you join the fight, or will you watch Western civilization die?_

Because here's what they don't understand about martyrdom: when darkness tries to snuff out light, it usually accomplishes the opposite.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3e4dfd1b-1f5c-4f83-bc91-c7bdc5f155aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Charlie Kirk's assassination awakened something they never expected...
Across America, people are opening their Bibles. They're turning to God. They're asking the deep questions that matter.
From the President down, _leaders are preaching the gospel and calling people to repentance._ College students who never set foot in church are suddenly seeking Truth. Parents are pulling their children from institutions that teach hatred and returning to the faith of their fathers.
This feels like another Great Awakening, doesn't it?
They killed Charlie Kirk thinking they could silence his message.
Instead, they've amplified it across the nation.
This is a spiritual battle for the soul of Western civilization itself. The other side has made their choice. They've drawn blood. They've declared war on everything we hold sacred.
As Thomas Sowell said: "The left takes its vision seriously - more seriously than it takes the rights of other people. They want to be our shepherds. But that requires us to be sheep."
Now you must choose.
The time for neutrality is over.

body:
It’s Jane Fonda! You may know me as an actor or as a bit of a troublemaker in Washington for, well, decades. And I’m proud to still be at it.
There’s a lot of noise in politics these days, but when you find someone like my dear friend California Attorney General Rob Bonta, you pay attention.
Rob and I have been in the climate fight together for some time now, and I can say with my whole heart he’s exactly the kind of leader I had in mind when I launched the Jane Fonda Climate PAC: someone who listens to their community, stands up to powerful polluters, and never hesitates to put people over profits.
His office has brought some of the most historic lawsuits against oil and gas giants to date — holding them accountable for decades long campaigns of deception that have hurt our communities.
But Rob’s sense of justice has put California squarely in the crosshairs of Big Oil and Donald Trump . So now it’s our turn to have Rob’s back. Will you make a donation today to directly support his reelection campaign for California Attorney General? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25?express_lane=true&amount=10] DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25?express_lane=true&amount=25]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25?express_lane=true&amount=50] DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25?express_lane=true&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25?express_lane=true&amount=250] OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25]
When it comes to people who abuse their power and put our communities at risk, Rob doesn’t look the other way. He takes them on.
His office filed a groundbreaking lawsuit against some of the biggest oil companies in the world — ExxonMobil, Shell, Chevron, ConocoPhillips, and BP — along with the American Petroleum Institute. For decades they lied to the public, covered up the truth about climate change, and put their profits above our health and the health of our planet.
Rob is making sure these polluters finally answer for violating the law and lying to the public.
And while Trump and his MAGA allies work overtime to dismantle hard-fought solutions to the climate crisis, Rob unleashed a flurry of lawsuits over their attempts to freeze federal climate funding, halt offshore wind projects, and dismantle California’s environmental safeguards.
That’s what makes him different: As Attorney General, Rob isn’t just calling out Donald Trump and Big Oil — he’s dragging them into places where they can finally be held accountable.
But no one, not me, not even someone as fearless as Rob can do this work alone. It will take all of us rolling up our sleeves, joining the fight, and chipping in what we can to protect this seat from whoever Republicans throw into this race.
I’m asking again because this race truly matters for the future of our country: Will you join me in supporting Attorney General Rob Bonta by making your very own donation to his reelection campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-25]
Your donation, along with contributions like it from people all over the country, is how we will defend this critical seat and chip away at Trump’s dangerous agenda once and for all.
Thank you so much for being a part of this movement.
With gratitude,
Xx Jane Fonda

name: Erika Kirk, Turning Point USA
subject: This is the man Charlie really was...
body:
[unsubscribe](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xul=o5pvyewrzrxe8xiau9slbgewvrri57nr85ouc1arweqeykaz8eisapunamu7ytyqtpcxq7pi9wolo7qw8b2mrficxdrjoov0mj0cvj7&__stmp=t33y7g&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)

Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *
| | | |
---
Friend, I don’t know how else to begin except with this:

** _I miss him._**

Every breath. Every heartbeat. Every memory I now replay in my mind... I miss him.

My husband, Charlie Kirk, was the love of my life.

You may know him as a fighter for freedom. A warrior for truth. The founder of Turning Point USA. The host of a nationally syndicated radio show. A bold conservative voice that gave courage to a generation.

But to me... _He was just Charlie._
---
---
He was my best friend. The father of our two precious babies. The man who made me laugh when the world felt too heavy.

The man who, every single morning without fail, would look at me and ask: _“How can I love you better today?”_

That’s who Charlie really was. _That’s who I fell in love with._

**And I want to tell you that story, Friend.**

We met at what I thought was a job interview.

Charlie messaged me in August of 2018 — very Charlie-like — short, direct, and bold:

_“Hey, I need to meet with you. Urgently.”_

I thought it was about a position with Turning Point. It wasn’t.

He took me to Bill’s Burgers in NYC. I thought I was about to be grilled for a role... and instead, I was grilled about Aristotle, theology, the Constitution, and how I saw my future.

Three and a half hours of deep conversation, and by the end of it, I still didn’t know what to think.

**Then Charlie looked at me and said:**

_**“I’m not going to hire you. I’m going to date you.”**_

I froze. I told him, “Maybe we should just be friends first.”

He didn’t skip a beat: _“I have enough friends.”_

That was Charlie.

Clarity. Conviction. A heart that always knew exactly what it wanted. And completely unshakable when he knew what was right.

God knew I needed someone who would say, “I'm not playing games. I'm not going to play with your heart. I'm a loyal person. I'm a good person. I'm a God-fearing person. I want to date you.”

**God just knew that I needed someone like that. And He said, "Here's Charlie."**

We fell fast — and we fell deep.

It wasn’t glamorous. Our lives were chaotic. Travel, pressure, early mornings, and late nights.

_But we understood each other..._

Charlie had found his mission. And I had found mine — _to stand by his side._
---
---
**He loved God. He loved me and our family. He loved America. He loved this movement.**

**Charlie also believed in you, Friend.**

He believed in the students who had never heard the truth before.

He believed in the greatness of America — even when things were dark or felt hopeless to us all.

Charlie was a father, a husband, a leader, and a warrior.

But above all, Charlie was obedient...

Obedient to God. To his conscience. To the mission placed on his heart.

**Charlie and I didn’t just build a life together — _we built a calling._**

And now...

**I don’t just bear his calling — I will lead.**

**I will lead the movement he built forward, in Charlie’s name and for God’s glory.**
---
---
Before Charlie died, he often repeated one verse more than any other:
---
_**"And I heard the voice of the Lord saying, 'Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?' Then I said, 'Here I am! Send me.'”**_ _**~ Isaiah 6:8** _
---
**Charlie answered that call every day of his life. Now, it’s my turn.**

And if you’re reading this — _maybe it’s yours, too._

We are all being called.

To serve. To love boldly. To stand. To fight for what matters.

Because Charlie’s life was not taken in vain.

The evil that tried to silence him has only made his voice louder.

We will carry the torch, Friend.

Together.

And the mission Charlie started — it will become greater than we ever imagined.

Because God is not done.

And neither are we.

With faith, love, strength, and unshakable hope...
---
---
**Erika Kirk**
CEO & Chair of the Board Turning Point USA [_**Support Turning Point USA**_](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t33y7g&__onlt=h)
---
**P.S.** Friend, you may have seen this already, but I want to share this with you anyways...

Charlie loved witnessing excellence. It’s why he loved sports so much.

He loved watching the best of the best perform at the level of greatness God intended for them.

Friend, that’s why this photo... _One of the very last photos ever taken of Charlie..._

...Took the breath right out of my chest:
---
---
Because I know that look... _**I fell in love with that look.**_

He’s in athlete mode. Locked in. Dialed. Focused.

It’s how I first met him — _driven, intense, humble, and joyful in the simplest moments._

Just Charlie. _In his element._

I remembered the early days of dating, us on a basketball court. No lights, no crowd, no noise — just the sound of sneakers on pavement.

We bonded over how Jordan was the GOAT, and he told me about his basketball days in high school and I told him about my basketball days in college.

He wore a red bracelet on his wrist that read: _**“Work harder. Be better.”**_

He never took it off. Until one day, a student came up to him after a speech and asked about it. Charlie slipped it off and gave it to them.

That was who he was. He saw greatness in others, _even when they couldn’t yet see it in themselves._

**That’s what I see in this photo — _Greatness._**

**To me, this is Charlie’s “Jordan” photo.**

_Because this was his prime..._

_Because this was Charlie at the height of everything he lived for — his purpose, his calling, his mission..._

He trained his whole life for this exact moment, the moment he’d be called home.

He gave it everything. Mind. Body. Soul.

And now, this image is permanently etched in time, held in my heart, as I admire his greatness. _Forever._

Friend, I want you to know — his mission didn’t end. It won’t ever stop...

**Because it’s alive in me. It’s alive in our children. It’s alive in the millions he’s inspired.**
****
**And if you’re reading this, I know it’s alive in you, too.**

Friend, Charlie’s life — it was so much bigger than politics...

It was about a man laying down his life, every single day, for something eternal.

And now, he’s running his race where it really counts — _where it never ends._

**Charlie, I miss you.**

I pray you’re having the most amazing time in Heaven.

And Charlie, baby, I promise I will never let your legacy slow or go silent.

I promise I'll make Turning Point USA the biggest thing that this nation has ever seen. I promise.

I love you, baby. Rest in the arms of our Lord as he blankets you with the words I know your heart _always_ strived to hear:

_**“Well done, my good and faithful servant.”**_

You lived life well. You earned it.

**And I promise...**

**I’ll carry the torch you lit from here._We’ll all carry it from here._**
---

Rest in the arms of our Lord as he blankets you with the words I know your heart always strived to hear: “Well done, my good and faithful servant.” You lived life well. You earned it. And I promise... I’ll carry the torch you lit from here.We’ll all carry it from here.** 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 / / AFFILIATE DISCLOSURE NOTICE: You should assume the sender of this message has a financial or affiliate relationship with the persons or companies referenced and may be compensated for purchases made via linked sites. My god, Peter.
If you thought _ _ Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. firing the CDC director for defending the scientifically-backed childhood vaccine schedule was the end of his attacks on science, you should know that there is likely no end to the disinformation he is willing to push out.
**In what may have been the most uninformed, dangerous “health” briefing in my lifetime, RFK Jr. stood behind Trump as he declared – without a shred of proof – ****that the FDA will now add to drug labels that acetaminophen (or Tylenol) use by pregnant women can cause autism.**
His claims about the common pain and fever reducer don't just fly in the face of scientific studies – **for years, it's been recommended as the _only_ safe OTC option for pregnant women to use.**
Just read what Trump had to say to pregnant women!
| | |

"Don't take Tylenol ... You'll be uncomfortable. It won't be as easy, maybe. But don't take it if you're pregnant. Don't take Tylenol, and don't give it to the baby after the baby is born ... There's no downside – **other than a mother will have to, as I say, tough it out a little bit.** "
---
– PRESIDENT TRUMP
---
|
---

**1. DO NOT** listen to Trump or RFK Jr. when it comes to vaccines, Tylenol, or anything having to do with your health. **Ask your doctor.**
**2. DO NOT let up the pressure to FIRE RFK Jr.** – because America has never been less healthy and less safe at any other time in recent memory.
**3\. DO NOT let the Senate GOP majority who put him in power think they can endanger American lives and get away with it come the midterms.**

Dear Peter,
Just a couple weekend's ago at the 2025 Massachusetts Democratic Convention, Governor Maura Healey delivered a powerful address about who we are as Democrats and why Massachusetts must continue to lead the way forward for our country.
Governor Healey reminded us that:
"We choose always hope over fear, empathy over anger, unity over division."
Massachusetts has built the best schools, the strongest economy, and a healthier, fairer future for every family.
When Washington fails, Massachusetts steps up: protecting health care, expanding education, defending democracy, and standing against hate and violence.
Watch Governor Healey's Convention Speech below:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=udPyy5bpzV0 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=udPyy5bpzV0]
Her message was clear: the work is never done, and we need all of us to keep organizing, keep fighting, and keep moving Massachusetts forward.
Together, we’ve always been at the forefront of progress — from marriage equality to universal health care, from expanding housing to protecting reproductive rights. And together, we’ll keep leading.
Thank you for being part of this movement. Let’s get to work.
In solidarity,
MassDems

I grew up here, I’m raising my family here, and I’m stepping up to fight for our future.
| | | | |

| | | | |

| _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td05c702f-8055-4f11-8f52-c93fc07a411b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T70127c8f-1caa-4758-9da6-48479e0b1814/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I’m James Leuschen, and I’m announcing my campaign for Congress in Nebraska’s 2nd District. I grew up here in Omaha, attended Central High and Creighton, playing and coaching football along the way, and now I’m raising my three boys with my wife, Janelle, just a mile from where I grew up. This community has shaped me at every stage of my life, and it’s why I’m running for Congress, because Nebraska’s families deserve someone who will fight for them, not Donald Trump’s agenda of chaos. When I was a senior in high school, my dad was killed in a car accident. What got us through that hardship was our neighbors, our church, and the protections of Social Security survivor benefits. That experience is what led me to public service. For the past 20 years, I was honored to serve in senior staff leadership roles in the U.S. House of Representatives, including as Policy Director to former Democratic Majority Leader Steny Hoyer. As an economic policy expert, I worked on some of the most important issues facing Nebraska families — from the passage and expansion of the Affordable Care Act to expanding the Child Tax Credit that put more money in the pockets of working families. I know what is at stake in this election and just how dangerous Donald Trump is. When our democracy was attacked on January 6th, I was barricaded with my colleagues inside the U.S. Capitol while our office was ransacked on the other side of the door. This race won’t be easy, but Nebraska’s 2nd has shown time and time again that we don’t just vote down party lines. Voters here choose the person who they think will best fight for them, and I know with you and others on my team, Peter, we can earn the trust we need to win. Together, we can send a new voice to Washington, one rooted in our values and committed to putting people first. But that starts with us. From Omaha to Ashland to Yutan, we need a campaign built from the ground up by people who care about their families, their neighbors, and their future. That’s why I’m proud to partner with Blue Amp Action because together we can build the strongest grassroots campaign possible. [Will you split a donation of $25 between my campaign and Blue Amp Action to help kickstart this fight together?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc39eab8c-31cd-43b0-835a-d836c20f283e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

This is the most personal letter I’ve ever written.
---
I’m writing to you not as America’s Mayor, not as a former prosecutor, not even as President Trump’s former attorney, but as an 80-year-old man – a grandfather and a patriot – staring down a 20-year prison sentence for doing what I believed was right.
_Or so I thought..._
**...But now, a Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
They think they’ve finally got me! Left me with no escape, no lifeline – especially after they’ve already STRIPPED me of my law licenses!
_No pardon.
No protection.
No cavalry coming over the hill._
But even though the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful _force_ absolutely can: _THE AMERICAN PEOPLE_.

36% of Colorado is public land – and I need your help to protect all 24 million acres for the next generation.
| | |

Friend – if you know me, you know that hiking is my favorite way to get outdoors.
So with an outdoors as great as Colorado's, there's no better place in the nation to enjoy the fresh air, breathtaking vistas and diverse wildlife than the 24 million acres of public lands right in here in our backyards.
**But it seems Donald Trump and his Republican allies do not share our same values.** Just the other week, the Trump administration began the process of revoking the 2024 Public Lands Rule so that leasing our lands to corporate drilling, mining and logging interests takes official priority over safeguarding these wild spaces for future generations.
**So I'm asking for your help to keep our public lands in public hands.[Will you chip in $5 to join me in the fight to keep public lands free and available for all to use?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115854831/571687275/851209409?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk925-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MzgzOGNiZS04MTk5LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RhYQ8mfzaZxJuqMyK_YVqS01hFyKILTS9ZqtTKu5t8E=)**

After years of meeting and speaking with folks from all over our state while on the trail, one thing is clear: **Coloradans care just as deeply about preserving these majestic wild spaces as I do.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115854833/571687277/851209409?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk925-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MzgzOGNiZS04MTk5LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RhYQ8mfzaZxJuqMyK_YVqS01hFyKILTS9ZqtTKu5t8E=)
That's why, over my time in the U.S. Senate, some of my proudest achievements have been preserving our public lands – from establishing the Camp Hale-Continental Divide National Monument, to prohibiting oil and gas leasing in the Thompson Divide, to protecting more than 100,000 acres of the Hermosa Creek Watershed.
But Donald Trump and his allies have different priorities. Between trying to lease our lands, illegal funding cuts and the failed effort to sell off more than 3 MILLION acres of public lands into private hands, their reckless, out-of-touch agenda is a **threat** to Colorado's outdoors, our economy and our way of life.
Unlike them, I believe it's our shared responsibility to build a brighter future for our state and the generations who inherit it from us.

Protecting our outdoor wonders, and pushing for bold climate action, is just a part of fulfilling that duty.
**So as governor, I will never waver in my commitment to protecting Colorado's great outdoors. With Donald Trump in office, I’ll not only lead the fight against his efforts to roll back our progress, but we will show how, at the state level, Colorado can lead the way in expanding protections for our parks, lands and open spaces. Our kids and grandkids deserve nothing less – **but I can't keep this promise without your support, friend, since I'm running a 100% grassroots-powered race.

Just the other week, the Trump administration began the process of revoking the 2024 Public Lands Rule so that leasing our lands to corporate drilling, mining and logging interests takes official priority over safeguarding these wild spaces for future generations. So I'm asking for your help to keep our public lands in public hands.= | | = After years of meeting and speaking with folks from all over our state while on the trail, one thing is clear: Coloradans care just as deeply about preserving these majestic wild spaces as I do. = That's why, over my time in the U.S. Senate, some of my proudest achievements have been preserving our public lands – from establishing the Camp Hale-Continental Divide National Monument, to prohibiting oil and gas leasing in the Thompson Divide, to protecting more than 100,000 acres of the Hermosa Creek Watershed. But Donald Trump and his allies have different priorities. Between trying to lease our lands, illegal funding cuts and the failed effort to sell off more than 3 MILLION acres of public lands into private hands, their reckless, out-of-touch agenda is a threat to Colorado's outdoors, our economy and our way of life. Unlike them, I believe it's our shared responsibility to build a brighter future for our state and the generations who inherit it from us. Protecting our outdoor wonders, and pushing for bold climate action, is just a part of fulfilling that duty. So as governor, I will never waver in my commitment to protecting Colorado's great outdoors. With Donald Trump in office, I’ll not only lead the fight against his efforts to roll back our progress, but we will show how, at the state level, Colorado can lead the way in expanding protections for our parks, lands and open spaces. Our kids and grandkids deserve nothing less – but I can't keep this promise without your support, friend, since I'm running a 100% grassroots-powered race. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | = | | = | = Thank you for all you do, Michael | Bennet for Governor PO Box 270117 Louisville, CO 80027 United States Paid for by Bennet for Governor. At Voter Action Project, Team, we believe that voting is a fundamental right , not a privilege or some test of everyone's endurance and ability to wait in a long line. We believe that our right to vote is the core bedrock that makes up our democracy and needs to be defended, expanded, and celebrated.
However, as the Voting Rights Act -- a historic piece of legislation that stood for voting as a fundamental right for every American -- recently turned 60 years old, it is being eviscerated to stop voters and their lawyers from defending that freedom to vote in court.
Conservatives on the United States Supreme Court have spent the last two decades slowly tearing the VRA to pieces. In the hands of opponents of voting rights, the Voting Rights Act has faced death by a thousand cuts. Some of those cuts have been small, such as limiting how courts consider challenges brought under the law. And some have been large, as in the 2013 decision in Shelby County v. Holder that ended the requirement for certain states with histories of discrimination to submit election changes and district maps to the Department of Justice for approval.
As the Supreme Court holds over another case, hell-bent on dismantling the Voting Rights Act piece by piece, we have to fight to protect our fundamental rights.
Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to stand up for the VRA and help us protect voting rights nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=092425_2&amount=25]

Doubt us? The U.S. Supreme Court is now set to hear oral argument in Callais v. Landry — the high-stakes Louisiana redistricting case that could upend the Voting Rights Act — on October 15.
This will be the second time the nation’s highest court hears oral argument in the pivotal voting rights case. This fall, the argument will focus on whether Louisiana’s creation of a second majority-minorty district under the VRA violates the U.S. Constitution.
This is a key opportunity for Chief Justice John Roberts, who has taken every opportunity since being appointed to the court by President George W. Bush to destroy the VRA. This case could take out one of the last legs holding the law up in favor of equality and our fundamental right to have our voice heard in an election.

body:
Learn how you can get involved to elect Toni as CA's next Governor!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b55e8638c30c/welcome-to-team-toni-lets-get-to-work-4934094?e=199d0c411d)

| | | | | | Hi,
This week we spoke with **hundreds of voters** across San Diego County! These conversations reminded voters about the governor’s race, informed them about Toni’s positions on the issues, and identified more supporters interested in joining Team Toni. Over 40 volunteers have taken action for Toni, with some joining us as many as six times! Thank you to our volunteers for your continued support.
If you are interested in joining our growing team of volunteers, register for one of our upcoming volunteer events listed below. We look forward to you taking action with us to help elect Toni Atkins as California’s next governor!
As Governor, Toni would strengthen the visibility of the LGBTQ+ community, tackle the affordability crisis, and protect Californians’ rights against infringements. **But Toni can’t do it alone.** If we want her brighter vision for California to become a reality, **it’s going to take all of us** — starting right now.
-Team Toni

Judicial Watch announced today that a hearing is scheduled for
Friday, September, 26, 2025, in the class action civil
rights lawsuit filed against Evanston, Illinois, on behalf of six
individuals over the city’s reparations program (Flinn et al. v
Evanston (No. 1:24-cv-04269)).

The court ordered the in-person hearing for oral argument on
Evanston’s pending motion to dismiss the lawsuit.

Judicial Watch filed the lawsuit over the city’s use of race as an
eligibility requirement for a reparations program, which makes $25,000
direct cash payments to black residents and descendants of black
residents who lived in Evanston between the years 1919 and 1969.

**Arizona's electoral independence is under attack.** The Trump administration is demanding our state hand over Arizona voters' complete personal information — including dates of birth, addresses, and Social Security numbers — to the Department of Justice. **This isn't about election security. This is about federal control over Arizona's elections.** According to the Brennan Center for Justice, Arizona is one of at least 21 states that Trump’s DOJ has targeted for voter roll information. Our Democratic Secretary of State, Adrian Fontes, has refused to comply, citing Arizona law that makes it a felony for public officials to release this sensitive voter data. **But this is bigger than one request. This is about whether Arizona controls its own elections.** Trump has already announced plans to eliminate mail-in voting used by _over 85% of Arizona voters,_ and he’s demanding voter ID requirements in all states. Now, he also wants access to every Arizona voter's personal information. This is a systematic assault not just on our state’s electoral independence, but also on our personal privacy and our rights. [**Will you support the Arizona Democratic Party as we defend our state's right to run its own elections?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115857953/571697896/548103770?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20250924_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzU2ODgxZTgtOGQ5OS1mMDExLWI0ODQtNjA0NWJkZWI3NDEzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=IgIscLy798El7mAB42MDwHe3VEK7j4KWVYrPXhOv6pg=) | [CHIP IN TO PROTECT AZ’s ELECTIONS](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115857954/571697897/1948356670?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20250924_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzU2ODgxZTgtOGQ5OS1mMDExLWI0ODQtNjA0NWJkZWI3NDEzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=IgIscLy798El7mAB42MDwHe3VEK7j4KWVYrPXhOv6pg=)

Peter – I know that the headlines right now are depressing, and it can be easy to lose hope with constant negative news.

**But when we put in the work, we can still rack up important wins.**

I am proud to report that we stopped a harmful amendment on the House floor last week that would have slowed the development of offshore wind and affordable energy for Rhode Islanders.

And last week’s win in congress was followed by a win in the courts this week, which ruled that the Revolution Wind project off the coast of Rhode Island can proceed.

When we fight, we can win. Even in these challenging times, we are still able to score important victories for hard working Rhode Islanders.

And this is why we have to flip the House — with a majority in the House, we will be able to do even more to deliver for the American people and fight back against extremism.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: How the economy is rigged against hardworking Americans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=2656%2E4032634%2E5L8aZS

This is a bit of a longer note from me, but
I believe it’s the exact conversation we need to be having right now as
Democrats. I recently sat down with the New York Times to talk about where
America goes from here — and what Democrats need to do to win. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3154?t=1006&akid=2656%2E4032634%2E5L8aZS ]You can
read or listen to it here.

The discussion centers around a topic I have spent my whole career
investigating: How the economy is rigged against hardworking Americans.

I wrote about this in my book, “The Two-Income Trap,” when I was a
bankruptcy lawyer back in 2003. I was looking at why so many American
families in the ’80s and ’90s found themselves in bankruptcy court. These
families had done everything right, and then one of three things happened:
they faced huge medical debt, experienced extended job loss, or had a
death or divorce in the family.

The point I was trying to emphasize was that the American economy had
shifted in a way that loaded the dice against middle-class families — even
if they played by the rules. One unfortunate circumstance could send a
family into bankruptcy. And that was fundamentally wrong.

This is a problem we should have solved long ago. And I’m furious we
haven’t.

People all across this country continue to feel like the game is rigged
against them. And they’re right. It is. The fact of the matter is that
Donald Trump capitalized on this ahead of his 2016 run when Democrats did
not. He wasn’t afraid to say that the game is rigged against regular
Americans. He talked about how things are “rigged” every day.

Now, does he do anything to actually make that problem better? Absolutely
not. He gains power, turns around to blame everything on immigrants, and
makes the economy much worse for working people. And I’ll get to how we
need to continue to make that clear.

But still, he knows this is an effective strategy. When he ran for
president in 2024, he again recognized the pain that people are feeling
and said he was going to make their lives better economically.

He even bragged that the reason he won the election was, “Because I
promised on Day 1 to lower costs for American families.”

If we want to win votes, Democrats have to show that we get it, we have a
plan to deal with it, and we are by God determined to deliver on it.

As a party, we may not agree 100% down the line on every issue. But the
issue that voters tell us over and over and over and over again that they
care about the most is the economy. They care about their homes. They care
about their jobs. They care about their bills. They care about child care.
They care about inflation.

Democrats must speak to the real economic anxieties that families are
feeling right now, and have the courage to fight for the policies that
will make their lives easier — even if pundits say it’ll never happen or
if it bothers billionaires. This is one of the main reasons why Zohran
Mamdani won the New York City mayoral primary and is on his way to lead
the city.

We have to articulate our values, and then we have to demonstrate that we
really will fight like hell for them.

Not a nibble around the edge. Not a highly diluted version. A vision of
big, structural change — and results.

We can’t push back on people who say they’re struggling because we looked
at some spreadsheet that said people are actually doing okay.

No more “Hmm...” “Sure...” “Maybe a little bit...”

No more, “Yes, we want to make sure that everybody pays a fair share, but
we don’t really want to talk about what the taxes are.”

No more, “Yes, we want to put a little more money into child care, but you
know, a big package would be really expensive and the big donors don’t
want to pay taxes.”

Democrats have also got to make clear: Donald Trump is talking the talk,
but he is not delivering. We not only have to adopt a bolder economic
message — we need to also call him out on his lies and failed policies.

We must emphasize that Donald Trump is NOT making life better for working
people. He is giving free handouts to Mark Zuckerberg and Jeff Bezos by
cutting health care.

That Donald Trump is NOT lowering costs. He is utilizing tariffs to get
companies and leaders to suck up to him while costs get passed off to
consumers.

That Donald Trump is NOT making us safer. He is terrorizing people. He is
disappearing people in this country. He is tearing families apart.

Finally, we as Democrats — all of us together, including you — must retain
the optimism that better things are possible.

We can dream big again. I want people to understand that the things they
feel are out of reach — like housing, a good education, or a well-paying
job — only feel that way because of a bunch of policies we put in place.
What we have today didn’t happen because of gravity. It happened because
of a bunch of choices we made as a country. And we could just as easily
make different choices.

So that brings us to the choices we have to make right now. I’m going to
do everything in my power to ensure that Democrats make the right choices
when it comes to our priorities and our economic policies.

And as for you, I know
times are hard right now, and things feel scary. That is the point: Donald
Trump and the Republicans want us to feel powerless, get tired, and give
up.

But I need you to resist that urge.

I need you to believe in an America where you can change jobs and not have
to worry about whether or not you could lose your health care.

I need you to believe in an America where you can have a baby and know
that you won’t have to quit work to stay home, and that you will actually
be able to get high-quality child care.

I need you to believe in an America that works not for a handful at the
top, but that works for all of us.

If you can just feel the tiniest little spark of that belief, keep it
alive, stay in the fight, and we actually could make this happen.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3154?t=1007&akid=2656%2E4032634%2E5L8aZS ]There’s a whole lot more that we discussed. You can read and listen to
the full interview here.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth
