Dear Peter,
From the ecologically diverse Monte Rio Redwoods to the ruggedly beautiful Sonoma Coast Redwoods, we have protected and connected thousands of acres together in the past year.
But protecting forests is just the beginning. With your help, the League is reviving the redwood range . When we invest in public lands and take on large-scale redwood restoration projects, we create a cascade of economic opportunity that generates jobs, strengthens local communities, and revitalizes damaged forests. Simply put, a thriving ecosystem equals a thriving economy.
https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/evergreen-match [https://secure.savetheredwoods.org/a/evergreen-match]
Source: Assessing Restoration Economy within Redwood National and State Park, Socioeconomic Impact Study, April 2025. [https://www.savetheredwoods.org/wp-content/uploads/files/Report_Assessing-the-Restoration-Economy_RNSP_20250331.pdf]
These successes show we don’t have to choose between a “healthy ecosystem” and a “healthy economy.” We can, and should , have both!
That is the transformative, bold action you make possible, and it’s why I invite you to become an Evergreen Member right now and help us keep up this momentum.

name: Squad Victory Fund
subject: This is more than a policy debate
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20250924-1523-foote&t=1001&akid=1523%2E342411%2ERI66L5 ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

We’re at a pivotal moment in the fight for equality.

The Supreme Court could decide to revisit Obergefell v. Hodges, the
landmark ruling that secured marriage equality across the country.

If that decision is overturned, marriage equality could be wiped off the
map in 31 states — instantly.^1

These states have constitutional amendments or laws banning same-sex
marriage on the books, which were made unenforceable by Obergefell.^2 If
SCOTUS reverses course, those bans could snap back into effect overnight —
leaving millions of LGBTQ+ Americans without the right to marry, or to
have their marriages recognized, depending on where they live.

That would create a devastating patchwork of rights. Families could find
themselves married in one state and strangers in another. Parental rights,
spousal benefits, hospital visitation, and more could all be stripped
away.

We’re not going to let that happen — not without a fight.

The Squad Victory Fund is backing bold, unapologetic progressive
candidates who will defend marriage equality. We’re building power at the

name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is so good
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.
-------------------------

[Turning Point USA]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

Friend,

Even now... it still doesn’t feel real that we lost Charlie.

His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us.

And his vision — TO BUILD THE MOST FAITHFUL AND THE MOST PATRIOTIC
GENERATION IN AMERICAN HISTORY — is why Turning Point USA exists
today.

Friend, that’s why we have an inspiring update for you...

In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us,
Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students
who want to start or join a chapter:

[TPUSA tweet about 54,000 new chapters]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

GOD IS SO GOOD. ✝️🙏🕊️

To give you perspective, Friend...

Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+
college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters.

It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact...
_But now? _

These students who signed up? They weren’t asked to... They
weren’t recruited...

THEY FELT IT WAS THEIR TIME TO STAND UP FOR THIS COUNTRY AND HONOR
CHARLIE.

Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed
God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And
his vision of a better America for us all.

[TPUSA Students tweet about new Club America chapters]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

He always believed this day would come.

He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would
shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning
Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in
America.

And now...

_It’s happening._

Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible.

And more beautiful than we can even describe.

AGAIN, FRIEND, GOD IS SO GOOD.

Since we lost Charlie, we’ve also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers.
Emails. Messages.

Stories about how Charlie’s voice changed lives... or your
children’s or grandchildren's lives.

And so many supporters have asked, _“What can I do?”_

As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up
with every chapter request.

And we’re going to need help equipping them with our activism
kits.

EVERY NEW CHAPTER RECEIVES THESE KITS FROM TURNING POINT USA WITH
EVERYTHING THEY NEED TO GET STARTED — INCLUDING:

✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear

Friend, I’m sure you’d believe it when we say it... _this won’t
be a small task. _

But we’re going to do it. Whatever it takes. _FOR CHARLIE._

_And here’s how YOU can help with this..._

EVERY $25 YOU GIVE TODAY HELPS STOCK ANOTHER ACTIVISM KIT — READY TO
DEPLOY INTO A NEW TURNING POINT USA STUDENT CHAPTER...

How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of
new student chapters that are just getting started?

1 KIT = $25
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

2 KITS = $50
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

10 KITS = $250
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

100 KITS = $2,500
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

1,000 KITS = $25,000
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

SPONSOR ACTIVISM KITS
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make
Charlie’s vision a reality...

THIS IS IT.

[Students holding up TPUSA signs]
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-4b76bff741ea47708036aae04a906ed0/63]

Also...

HERE’S ONE MORE POWERFUL THING YOU CAN DO:

📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any
young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants
to join or start a chapter...

PLEASE SEND THEM THIS LINK: TPUSASTUDENTS.COM/STARTACHAPTER
[https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/ced6a088f9da4d398a4ed2bfdf12fe0f-290090fc1b084abc88f23667a47e667d/63]

Friend, if you’ve already given... If you’ve already donated...

If you’ve already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this
painful week...

If you’ve prayed, been praying, and continue to pray...

THANK YOU.

We can never say it enough.

If you’ve read this far, we want you to know this...

YOU’RE THE REASON CHARLIE’S MISSION AND VISION WILL GROW FOR
GENERATIONS TO COME.

God is so good.

FOR CHARLIE,

-The Turning Point USA Family

P.S. Please know, Friend, if you can’t afford to help right now, all
we ask for are your prayers.

Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that’s all
you can give today, _we’re grateful._

But if you’re able to help... if you’re overjoyed to hear that
students are flocking to Charlie’s message and mission...

Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and
gets new student chapters off the ground floor...

And ensures Charlie’s vision is realized faster than we all thought
possible.

EVERY $25 YOU GIVE TODAY HELPS US STOCK ANOTHER ACTIVISM KIT READY TO
DEPLOY TO A NEW STUDENT CHAPTER.

SPONSOR AN ACTIVISM KIT
MAKE YOUR GIFT HERE

Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend.

GOD IS SO GOOD. 🙏

4940 East Beverly Road
Phoenix, Arizona 85044

DCDailyJournal.com

* Dallas ICE facility shooter identified, updated details

# What we know so far about the Dallas ICE facility shooter:
A gunman identified as Joshua Jahn, 29, allegedly opened fire on an Immigration and Customs Enforcement facility in Dallas, TX, Wednesday morning, killing one person and wounding several others. He reportedly scrawled "ANTI-ICE" on ammunition found at the scene, authorities said.
Jahn**** died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound on a nearby rooftop after **[shooting at an unmarked van](https://substack.com/redirect/d470e559-2e82-40a1-bb7c-bf6f48d734c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** transporting detainees to the Dallas field office, police said.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c33c39a3-abb1-4ba2-a7f8-5a244c884726?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Facebook/Andy Jahn
The FBI is investigating the attack as targeted politically-motivated violence. No law enforcement officers were injured. The slain victim has been identified as a migrant, according to the Department of Homeland Security.
"Early evidence we've seen from rounds that were found near the suspected shooter contain messages that are anti-ICE in nature," said Joe Rothrock, special agent in charge of the FBI's Dallas office.
FBI Director Kash Patel said an "initial review of the evidence shows an ideological motive," calling it part of a pattern of attacks against immigration enforcement. Two similar shootings have targeted ICE or Customs and Border Protection agents in Texas since July.
Sen. Ted Cruz called for an end to anti-ICE rhetoric, saying "politically motivated violence is wrong" and urging politicians to "stop demonizing ICE and CBP."
Vice President JD Vance responded to the shooting scolding Democrats and the left wing media for their role in radicalizing bad actors into deadly action.
"[NBC] said that immigration enforcement had detained a 5-year-old autistic girl...when you go around and lie about our law enforcement...what do you think is gonna happen?"
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c61d6f6c-6f33-457e-8d4b-964fcf079ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The attack came hours after California Gov. Gavin Newsom criticized ICE as a "private domestic army" during a television appearance Tuesday night.
Investigators found Jahn's blue Toyota Corolla with a map showing radioactive fallout areas from 1950s nuclear testing attached to the exterior. His brother Noah told NBC News that Joshua wasn't politically interested and "didn't have strong feelings about ICE." This also comes in lieu of numerous Democrat officials **[spreading violent, extremist rhetoric](https://substack.com/redirect/e20ed4d8-2ae5-4f6d-ab80-f1898351d360?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** about ICE and border patrol in the past year.
The same facility was previously targeted with a bomb threat last month.

# Trump threatens to sue ABC over Jimmy Kimmel's return: "Bunch of losers"
President Donald Trump **[threatened to sue ABC](https://substack.com/redirect/d2c5358c-f57b-4587-ad9f-427ce5478d5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over Jimmy Kimmel's return to television, claiming the network acts as "another arm of the DNC" and constitutes an "Illegal Campaign Contribution," while referencing his previous $15 million settlement with ABC and suggesting this case could be "even more lucrative."
* **White House claims show was cancelled** : Trump expressed disbelief that ABC reinstated Kimmel, stating "The White House was told by ABC that his Show was cancelled!" and criticizing the decision to bring back someone with poor ratings who "puts the Network in jeopardy by playing 99% positive Democrat GARBAGE."
* **Kimmel 's defiant but limited apology**: Upon returning to air, Kimmel mentioned Charlie Kirk's name only once and offered a qualified statement saying it was "never my intention to make light of a murder," but failed to directly apologize for his inflammatory comments that originally got him pulled off the air.
* **Conservative backlash continues** : Critics accused Kimmel of playing the victim and using "crocodile tears," with conservative activist Jack Posobiec calling it the "DARVO playbook" (Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim and Offender) and Scott Jennings accusing Kimmel of lying about his original "MAGA gang" comments regarding Kirk's alleged assassin.

name: Kamala Harris
subject: For 107 days
body:
You have power as we head into the next elections.

Peter --
Do you remember the promise Donald Trump made on the campaign trail?
This person in the White House promised a whole lot of people one thing: He would bring down costs and prices.
**He lied to them.**
It was not just him by himself. Republicans around him perpetuated that lie and have not followed through on their promise.
Now, as Democrats try to protect health care and actually lower costs for the American people, Donald Trump will not even take their meeting.
He will not answer why he thinks it’s a good idea to cut Medicaid.
He will not answer why he is willing to shut down the government to make working people pay for the tax cut he gave the richest people in America.
Democrats are doing the job that any elected leader should do. We’re not going to do the bidding of the president at the sacrifice of our constituents' health care.
So let us be clear: It will not be the Democrats shutting down the government. It will be the Republicans.
We need to remember that as we head into the next elections.
Midterms are around the corner, and I hope to remind you that you have power.
Whether it is going to a protest, getting engaged, or using the power of your pocketbook -- you can make a difference.
And that is exactly what I am going to ask you to do today.
**[Please make a donation to my organization -- KDH for the People -- to help elevate the next generation of leadership in America. With 2026 elections just around the corner, we must do everything we can to fight for the possibilities we hoped for in those 107 days.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-ftp-em?refcode=em250924-sub&refcode2=739_2563979_nrbpOm&akid=739%2E2563979%2EnrbpOm)**

Thank you and take care,
Kamala Harris

body:
# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/203?t=1&akid=736%2E181023%2E8-gKyO)
Hey there,
One of my opponents in the race for Governor recently attacked me - and the voters who rejected him the last time he ran statewide — with **dangerous, debunked conspiracy theories about our elections.**
[](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/239?c0=jmb-em-q32025.A5XsW4&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20250924_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=736%2E181023%2E8-gKyO)
Let me be clear: **Michigan’s elections are safe, secure, and the results are an accurate reflection of the will of the people. Period.** That was true in 2020, when John James lost his statewide race — and it’s true today. In fact, the **2020 election was not just safe, secure, and accurate — it was also the most audited election in Michigan’s history,** with over **250 audits** reaffirming the results.
Those results showed clearly that Donald Trump and John James lost. No amount of lies, conjectures, or threats will change that. And now, the fact that James wants to be Michigan’s next governor and is _still_ denying the truth about 2020 is **dangerous and disqualifying.**
And frankly, it’s disappointing. We should all expect more from anyone who wants to lead our state. This kind of rhetoric undermines trust in our elections, threatens the safety of our hardworking election officials, poll workers, and their families, and escalates division and discord at a time when our leaders need to be bringing us together.
Our last three statewide elections broke records for turnout. They were transparent, they were safe, and they were secure. And look, I’ve run against sore losers and election deniers before. I can take them on again and _win_. And as I’ve always done, I will stand up to anyone, anytime who tries to stand in the way of Michiganders' voices and votes. No political rhetoric or threats will ever deter me from that mission.
**[That’s why I need your help. Your support today will help me fight back against these attacks, defend our election officials, and protect every Michigander’s right to a fair, secure vote. Will you chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can to stand with me - and stand up for Michigan’s democracy?](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/854?c0=jmb-em-q32025.OcO0Lx&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20250924_PM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=736%2E181023%2E8-gKyO)**

body:
Give me just a moment to explain why I’m asking for your donation today.
| | |
---
Derek, we’re about to face the first significant test of our campaign’s financial strength.
At the end of this month, we will be filing the first of our quarterly fundraising reports with the FEC.
You know what this means by now: Our opponent and his national Republican allies will soon see how much we’ve raised — they’ll see any drop in our fundraising numbers as evidence of weakness, and they’ll determine what they need to spend against us this fall and beyond based on that number.
**[Our end-of-quarter online goal is $555,000, and I’m reaching out personally to ask if you can start us off by splitting a donation of anything that is right for you between my team and John Fetterman's campaign today.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51696?t=1&akid=10326%2E434096%2ELXYK-9)**
In recent weeks, the RNC made moves to start directing funds to our opponent even earlier than usual. This comes as no surprise — we’ve long known that our race could become the _most expensive_ U.S. Senate contest in history. The GOP is ready to commit any amount to defeating us.
The GOP machine can try to buy this seat, Derek, but I know that we can defeat them by standing together. **After all, we’ve won some of the toughest races in North Carolina before.**
**[One of the most important ways you can help show that we have what it takes to win is by donating before our end-of-quarter deadline. We need to show that we’re bringing more supporters onto our team than our opponent and that our momentum continues to grow. name: Team Jayapal
subject: Trump’s coming after federal employees… again
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Workers’ rights are under attack. Pramila’s fighting back.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250924-5466-footer&t=1&akid=5466%2E420207%2EuoYkY7)
Peter,
**Donald Trump just stripped away bargaining rights from more than 1 million federal workers** , securing his place in history as the worst union-busting president in modern history.
After months of relentless attacks from Elon Musk and MAGA, Trump is piling on federal employees and taking his coordinated assault on labor rights to a new low.
More than 400,000 Department of Veterans Affairs workers have already had their union contract ripped up, along with basic workplace protections. More agencies could be next.
**Here’s how this impacts federal workers:**
* No right to negotiate for better pay, hours, and working conditions
* No collective voice in the workplace
* No right to organize
* No authority to represent them in disputes
* No way for workers to fight unfair termination (which we know is one of this administration’s favorite pastimes)

This is an all-out assault on workers’ rights — and obvious retaliation against federal employees who _dared_ to speak out or challenge Trump in court.
But Trump can’t change the facts: **Every worker has the right to join a union** — and that includes federal workers.
If we don’t stand up now, the assault on labor rights will only get worse. We need a fearless, pro-labor champion who’s ready to fight back and win for workers.
That’s why Pramila is working to create a Workers’ Bill of Rights, protect every worker’s right to organize, make the minimum wage a living wage, and secure fair pay and rights for gigworkers, farmworkers, and more.
**Because she knows there is no justice without economic justice for working class people across the country.**
[**Peter, will you chip in $3 to power our pro-labor movement and help Pramila keep up the fight to stop Trump’s union-busting agenda?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250924-2?refcode=em20250924-5466&amount=3&refcode2=5466_420207_uoYkY7&akid=5466%2E420207%2EuoYkY7)

name: Justice Democrats
subject: Tom Homan took a $50,000 bag of cash
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last year, Tom Homan — Donald Trump’s current border czar — accepted a
$50,000 bag of cash from two FBI agents posing as businessmen, in exchange
for help winning lucrative government contracts related to border security
if Trump won the 2024 election.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em20250924-signup-firehoman?source=em20250924-37052&akid=37052%2E1203867%2EQCJo_- ]A CNN news headline reads, 'Report alleges Trump border czar Tom Homan
accepted bag of $50K in FBI sting.' The subheading states, 'Tom Homan, now
the president's border czar, was recorded last year accepting a bag with
$50,000 in cash by undercover FBI agents in an...' To the right is a small
image of Tom Homan in a suit speaking outdoors in front of microphones.

The exchange was recorded on tape, as the FBI was investigating Homan for
bribery and other potential crimes. Of course, once Trump was sworn back
into office, Homan got a top role in the administration, and the
investigation was dropped.

It’s obvious what’s going on here: Attorney General Pam Bondi and FBI
Director Kash Patel shut down the investigation in a cover-up to protect
one of Trump’s biggest allies.

It’s just one of countless examples of the corruption taking place within
the MAGA White House, especially when it comes to Trump’s mass deportation
agenda.

Trump and Republicans’ budget bill nearly tripled the ICE budget this
summer, while ICE and the Department of Homeland Security are issuing
BILLIONS of dollars in federal contracts to private prisons and other
corporations.

The same private prisons that donated millions to Donald Trump’s election
are now cashing in, making a fortune from the terrorization of our
communities and the drastic spike in the number of people arrested and

body:
"To have a great nation, you have to have religion. There has to be something after we go through all of this, and that something is God." \- President Trump As a retired Navy SEAL, I've seen my fair share of battles. And let me tell you, I've lost Brothers in the fight for our nation's freedom. But through it all, I've held onto one thing that's kept me going: my faith.
And I'm not alone.
Our nation was founded on Christian values, and it's those values that have made us great. But today, our Christian values are under attack like never before.

Peter,
Prepare to see a lot of headlines about Pennsylvania’s State Supreme Court race.
According to _The Downballot_ , conservative operatives are airing ads urging the state’s voters to oust three pro-democracy justices in the upcoming November elections. They’ve pledged to spend millions of dollars going after judicial candidates this year.
Listen, Peter, Pennsylvania is a battleground state that will be crucial in the next presidential election. And control of the Keystone State’s Supreme Court will determine whether or not free and fair elections are protected for years to come.
**Let’s be clear: In 2018, the court struck down an effort to gerrymander Pennsylvania's maps. So now, anti-democracy forces want to remove justices from the bench to ensure they can pursue their goal of extreme partisan redistricting.**
Looking ahead to the outcome of this critical election, we know these justices will make court decisions that will impact the lives of Pennsylvanians and the future of our democracy on issues ranging from blatant map manipulation and voting rights to reproductive freedom.
**All On The Line is mobilizing voters to engage in Pennsylvania and critical state-level races across the country to ensure we have fair maps and a democracy that represents the will of the people.**

---
I grew up in Butte, Nebraska – a town of 400 people. There were 24 kids in my high school class. Living in a small town, you learn early on what it means to look out for your neighbors and to serve others.
That call to service is what led me to enlist in the Army National Guard just two days after my 17th birthday. I was proud to wear the uniform of this country for the next 24 years.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95485?refcode=em20250924-9474&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=9474%2E614464%2EYxVCiI)
My drive to serve others eventually set me on a new path: teaching. My wife Gwen and I met while teaching high school. Kids carry their whole lives with them into the classroom and Gwen and I got to know our students and see the obstacles they faced. **It was my experience as a teacher and my passion for education that led me to run for governor.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95485?refcode=em20250924-9474&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=9474%2E614464%2EYxVCiI)
Serving as Governor of Minnesota has been the honor of my life, and I couldn’t be prouder of the progress we’ve won. From providing universal free school meals for students, to protecting reproductive freedom, and cutting taxes for the middle class, we’ve secured tangible results that Minnesotans can actually feel.
The values that inspired me to serve our country in uniform, become an educator, and run for governor are the same ones I still carry with me each day as I work for the people of Minnesota. I still believe in helping our neighbors, protecting our freedoms, and investing in the future for our next generation. And I believe that, despite Donald Trump and MAGA’s attempts to tear us apart, we are still all in this together.
**Right now, we have an opportunity to continue delivering progress for Minnesotans – but only if we hold onto this Governor seat.** That’s why I’m asking you to have my back today, Peter.
**[Would you split a donation between my campaign and State Democrats Committee? Thank you in advance for your support.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95485?refcode=em20250924-9474&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=12&akid=9474%2E614464%2EYxVCiI)**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/95485?refcode=em20250924-9474&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=9474%2E614464%2EYxVCiI)**
I’ll be in touch soon,
Tim Walz

# [Nexstar, Hypocrisy & The Rage of a New Generation](https://substack.com/redirect/fdfbdae5-c1bf-43a9-ab8b-06301b2928a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Folks, let's talk about who really pulls the strings in America's so-called "free press."
Jimmy Kimmel may be back on ABC, but let's not kid ourselves--giant, soul-sucking monopolies like Sinclair and Nexstar still poison the airwaves with propaganda.
Nexstar even runs _NewsNation_ , a pretend "straight news" network that's nothing but right-wing sewage with The Grinch's smile when the lights go down. If you know anyone watching it, tell them to shut it off. They'll immediately gain ~18.25 IQ points.
Second, they deserve better than corporate disinformation peddled by a company that makes elephant dung kept in a dumpster in the Dubai sun in the middle of August smell like Chanel No. 5.
Speaking of giant dung piles, over four in ten House Democrats just voted to honor Charlie Kirk. _You read that right_.

And/or for actual elected official, the late Minnesota St. House Speaker, Melissa Hortman, be added to the vote. A Democrat assassinated for her beliefs and votes.
So I must ask Democratic leadership, and 44% of the House Caucus who voted in favor of this thing (there were some absent, and some profiles in courage who voted "present"): **What. The. F. Are. You. Doing??**
Do you have any clue how to wield power? Do you intend to wield power?
What's sad is while they're not wielding power, the three of us were sitting having an honest discussion, with none of the security of elected officials have. [And knowing deep down this is a dangerous world](https://substack.com/redirect/fdfbdae5-c1bf-43a9-ab8b-06301b2928a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
So, as while most congressional Democrats were joining Republicans in giving a MAGA demagogue a special day, there was Chuck Grassley still in the Senate. A guy _who voted against_ _Martin Luther King Day_ in 1983.
Yes, this actually happened, And he's still there! Lucky for him it was only MLK, and not Charlie Kirk! I mean, the guy may yet break Methuselah's record for oldest earthbound being and still be in the Senate when it happens!

What with the decomposing Dear Leader, that leader's obvious ties to Jeffrey Epstein, an economy careening into a ditch like Matt Gaetz were driving it, and their never-ending billionaire fluffing, especially the weird ones Peter Thiel, [who's building a database of the whole country](https://substack.com/redirect/fdfbdae5-c1bf-43a9-ab8b-06301b2928a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

---|---|---
The show brought on Luke, 22-year-old from Iowa _who has blown up on TikTok_ with nearly a million followers. Why?
It's always good to talk to someone so passionately willing to fight these Nero-esque, neanderthal nimrods at a young age. Especially someone from from Iowa, which has recently gone from purple to red.
But also where Jodi Ernst just ran for the hills rather than reelection, once she got a view of the polling.
Luke, much like David and I, says what we're all feeling. He channels the unfiltered rage--of a country where Republicans happily line Trump's pockets while whining about feeding hungry kids.
His most viral video--16 million views!--was about free school lunches. He called out the hypocrisy of church-going parents who fought against _feeding kids_ , seemingly not knowing who some guy named Jesus was.
Then they had the gall to sing hymns about compassion on Sunday.
Luke's kind of righteous fury at this is contagious, and exactly what our country needs more of. And he won't back down, [even when the usuals threaten him](https://substack.com/redirect/fdfbdae5-c1bf-43a9-ab8b-06301b2928a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fdfbdae5-c1bf-43a9-ab8b-06301b2928a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

The UN trip, just Trump's latest global embarrassment.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fdfbdae5-c1bf-43a9-ab8b-06301b2928a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Trump's team even tried to blame UN staffers for the escalator breakdown, when it was one of his own staffers who hit the cutoff switch (can we maybe put something over the nuclear button?). Because, of course it was.
This is who the GOP worships. A clown propped up by lies, denial, and makeup thick enough to cover a corpse.
The through line in all of this? Cruelty.
Whether it's ripping a five-year-old girl from her father's arms, cutting off telework for disabled Americans in violation of federal law, [bullying online,](https://substack.com/redirect/fdfbdae5-c1bf-43a9-ab8b-06301b2928a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or turning school lunches into culture war--Republicans never miss a chance to punch down.
That's not politics, that's sociopathy.
And you can fight it like hell now, or learn to live under it later. There is no in between.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3475231b-9872-467d-8e34-3487b46030b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
